import { Pipe, PipeTransform } from '@angular/core';
import { DomSanitizer, SafeHtml, SafeStyle, SafeScript, SafeUrl, SafeResourceUrl } from '@angular/platform-browser';

@Pipe({
  name: 'safe',
  standalone:true
})
export class SafePipe implements PipeTransform {

  constructor(protected _sanitizer: DomSanitizer){

  }

  transform(value: string, type:string): SafeResourceUrl {
    if(type == "url"){
      return this._sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustResourceUrl(value);
    }
    return "";
  }

}

import { createReducer, on } from "@ngrx/store";
import * as actions from "./fiddle.actions";

import { signal } from "@angular/core";
import { FiddleState } from "./fiddle.state";
import { FiddleApiResponseState } from "./fiddle-api-response.state";
import { fiddleThemeLight } from "../consts/fiddle-theme-light";



export const initialFiddleState: FiddleState = {
    fiddleData: {
        id: "",
        js: "",
        html: "",
        css: "",
        pastebintext: "",
        pastebintextSyntax: "Text",
        title: "",
        layout: 1,
        htmlPartSize: 0,
        cssPartSize: 0,
        jsPartSize: 0,
        codesPartSize: 0,
        mainContainerSize: 0,
        mainContainerHeight: 0,
        mainContainerWidth: 0,
        mobileLayout: "1:1",
        iframeResizeValue: 0,
        isMobileMode: false,
        createdAt: 0,
        appMode: "fiddle"
    },
    runtimeLayoutData: {
        fiddleTheme: fiddleThemeLight,
        mobileLayoutData: {
            showHtmlForMobile: true,
            showCssForMobile: false,
            showJsForMobile: false,
            showResultForMobile: true,
        },
        fullScreenData: {
            isIframeFullScreen: false,

            isHtmlFullScreen: false,
            isCssFullScreen: false,
            isJsFullScreen: false,
        },
        generalData: {
            showIframeOverlay: true,
            mouseDownXorY: 0,
            isFiddleWidthInputDisabled: false,
            isFiddleHeightInputDisabled: false
        },
        windowSizesData: {
            windowHeight: 0,
            windowWidth: 0,
        },
        domElementsData: {
            mainContainer: undefined,
            codesPartArea: undefined,
        },
        codesPartStretchData: {
            previousCodesPartSizes: {
                layout: 1,
                htmlSize: 0,
                cssSize: 0,
                jsSize: 0,
                mainContainerSize: 0
            },
            codePartStretch: {
                state: false,
                index: -1
            },
        },
        componentsData: {
            htmlPartComponent: undefined,
            cssPartComponent: undefined,
            jsPartComponent: undefined,
            pastebinPartComponent: undefined,
            iframePartComponent: undefined,
        },
        partsSizesData: {
            iframeWidth: 0,
            iframeHeight: 0,
            emptyArea_1_Size: 0,
            emptyArea_2_Size: 0
        },
        guttersData: {
            isGutter1_dragging: false,
            isGutter2_dragging: false,

            isIframeGutter1_dragging: false,
            isIframeGutter2_dragging: false,

            isMainContainerGutter_dragging: false
        }

    },
    fiddlesHistoryList: {
        data: [],
        page: 1
    },
    loading: true,
    ressourcesLoading: false,
    fiddlesHistoryLoading: false,
    iframeLoading: false
}

export const initialFiddleApiResponseState: FiddleApiResponseState = {
    persistedFiddleData: {
        id: "",
        js: "",
        html: "",
        css: "",
        pastebintext: "",
        title: "",
        layout: 1,
        htmlPartSize: 0,
        cssPartSize: 0,
        jsPartSize: 0,
        codesPartSize: 0,
        mainContainerSize: 0,
        mainContainerHeight: 0,
        mainContainerWidth: 0,
        mobileLayout: "1:1",
        iframeResizeValue: 0,
        isMobileMode: false,
        createdAt: 0,
        appMode: "fiddle"
    }
}

export const fiddleStateReducer = createReducer(
    initialFiddleState,

    on(actions.updateFiddleDataAction, (state, actionProps) => {
        let obj: FiddleState = {
            fiddleData: { ...state.fiddleData, ...actionProps },
            runtimeLayoutData: { ...state.runtimeLayoutData },
            fiddlesHistoryList: { ...state.fiddlesHistoryList },

            loading: state.loading,
            ressourcesLoading: state.ressourcesLoading,
            fiddlesHistoryLoading: state.fiddlesHistoryLoading,
            iframeLoading: state.iframeLoading
        };

        return obj;
    }),

    on(actions.requestFiddleFromApiAction, (state, { id: string }) => {
        return {
            fiddleData: { ...state.fiddleData },
            runtimeLayoutData: { ...state.runtimeLayoutData },
            fiddlesHistoryList: { ...state.fiddlesHistoryList },

            loading: true,
            ressourcesLoading: state.ressourcesLoading,
            fiddlesHistoryLoading: state.fiddlesHistoryLoading,
            iframeLoading: state.iframeLoading
        };
    }),

    on(actions.requestFiddleApiErrorAction, (state, { message: string }) => {
        return {
            fiddleData: { ...state.fiddleData },
            runtimeLayoutData: { ...state.runtimeLayoutData },
            fiddlesHistoryList: { ...state.fiddlesHistoryList },

            loading: false,
            ressourcesLoading: false,
            fiddlesHistoryLoading: false,
            iframeLoading: state.iframeLoading
        };
    }),

    on(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction, (state, actionProps) => {
        return {
            fiddleData: { ...state.fiddleData },
            runtimeLayoutData: { ...state.runtimeLayoutData, ...actionProps },
            fiddlesHistoryList: { ...state.fiddlesHistoryList },

            loading: state.loading,
            ressourcesLoading: state.ressourcesLoading,
            fiddlesHistoryLoading: state.fiddlesHistoryLoading,
            iframeLoading: state.iframeLoading
        };
    }),

    on(actions.requestFiddlesHistoryListFromApiAction, (state) => {
        return {
            fiddleData: { ...state.fiddleData },
            runtimeLayoutData: { ...state.runtimeLayoutData },
            fiddlesHistoryList: { ...state.fiddlesHistoryList },

            loading: state.loading,
            ressourcesLoading: state.ressourcesLoading,
            fiddlesHistoryLoading: true,
            iframeLoading: state.iframeLoading
        };
    }),


    on(actions.updateFiddlesHistoryListAction, (state, actionProps) => {
        //console.log("updateFiddlesHistoryListAction actionProps = ", actionProps);

        let newFiddlesHistoryList = {
            data: actionProps.data,
            page: actionProps.page || state.fiddlesHistoryList.page,
            totalPages: actionProps.totalPages || state.fiddlesHistoryList.totalPages,
            total: actionProps.total || state.fiddlesHistoryList.total
        }

        return {
            fiddleData: { ...state.fiddleData },
            runtimeLayoutData: { ...state.runtimeLayoutData },
            fiddlesHistoryList: newFiddlesHistoryList,

            loading: state.loading,
            ressourcesLoading: state.ressourcesLoading,
            fiddlesHistoryLoading: false,
            iframeLoading: state.iframeLoading
        };
    }),

    on(actions.updateFiddlesHistoryListPageAction, (state, actionProps)=>{
        let newFiddlesHistoryList = {
            data: state.fiddlesHistoryList.data,
            page: actionProps.page,
            totalPages: state.fiddlesHistoryList.totalPages,
            total: state.fiddlesHistoryList.total
        }

        return {
            fiddleData: {...state.fiddleData},
            runtimeLayoutData: {...state.runtimeLayoutData},
            fiddlesHistoryList: newFiddlesHistoryList,

            loading: state.loading,
            ressourcesLoading: state.ressourcesLoading,
            fiddlesHistoryLoading: state.fiddlesHistoryLoading,
            iframeLoading: state.iframeLoading
        }
    }),
    ////////////
    on(actions.selectThemeAction, (state, { theme }) => {
        localStorage.setItem("myfiddle-theme", theme.id);
        return {
            fiddleData: { ...state.fiddleData },
            runtimeLayoutData: { ...state.runtimeLayoutData, fiddleTheme: theme },
            fiddlesHistoryList: { ...state.fiddlesHistoryList },

            loading: state.loading,
            ressourcesLoading: state.ressourcesLoading,
            fiddlesHistoryLoading: state.fiddlesHistoryLoading,
            iframeLoading: state.iframeLoading
        };
    }),

    on(actions.updateFiddleLoadingStatusAction, (state, actionProps) => {
        return {
            fiddleData: { ...state.fiddleData },
            runtimeLayoutData: { ...state.runtimeLayoutData, ...actionProps },
            fiddlesHistoryList: { ...state.fiddlesHistoryList },

            loading: actionProps.loading,
            ressourcesLoading: state.ressourcesLoading,
            fiddlesHistoryLoading: state.fiddlesHistoryLoading,
            iframeLoading: state.iframeLoading
        };
    }),

    on(actions.updateRessourcesLoadingStatusAction, (state, actionProps) => {
        return {
            fiddleData: { ...state.fiddleData },
            runtimeLayoutData: { ...state.runtimeLayoutData, ...actionProps },
            fiddlesHistoryList: { ...state.fiddlesHistoryList },

            loading: state.loading,
            ressourcesLoading: actionProps.loading,
            fiddlesHistoryLoading: state.fiddlesHistoryLoading,
            iframeLoading: state.iframeLoading
        };
    }),

    on(actions.updateFiddlesHistoryLoadingStatusAction, (state, actionProps) => {
        return {
            fiddleData: { ...state.fiddleData },
            runtimeLayoutData: { ...state.runtimeLayoutData, ...actionProps },
            fiddlesHistoryList: { ...state.fiddlesHistoryList },

            loading: state.loading,
            ressourcesLoading: state.loading,
            fiddlesHistoryLoading: actionProps.loading,
            iframeLoading: state.iframeLoading
        };
    }),

    on(actions.updateIframeLoadingStatusAction, (state, actionProps)=>{
        return{
            fiddleData: {...state.fiddleData},
            runtimeLayoutData: {...state.runtimeLayoutData},
            fiddlesHistoryList: {...state.fiddlesHistoryList},

            loading: state.loading,
            ressourcesLoading: state.loading,
            fiddlesHistoryLoading: state.loading,
            iframeLoading: actionProps.loading
        }
    })
)

export const fiddleApiResponseStateReducer = createReducer(
    initialFiddleApiResponseState,

    on(actions.updateFiddleDataApiResponseAction, (state, actionProps) => {
        let obj: FiddleApiResponseState = {
            persistedFiddleData: { ...actionProps },
        };
        return obj;
    }),
)

import { DocumentData, QueryDocumentSnapshot } from "firebase/firestore";
import { FiddleData } from "../models/fiddle-data";
import { GitlabSnippet } from "../models/gitlab-snippet";
import { RuntimeLayoutData } from "../models/runtime-layout-data";

export interface FiddleState {
    /**
     * Runtime Fiddle Data, including codes, layout, and screen parts sizes
     */
    fiddleData: FiddleData,

    /**
     * Runtime data related to layout management logic and implementations, including DOM elements, booleans, angular components, gutters and their positions, etc..
     */
    runtimeLayoutData: RuntimeLayoutData,

    fiddlesHistoryList: {
        data: Array<FiddleData & GitlabSnippet>,
        page?: number,
        totalPages?: number
        total?: number,
        fireBaseLastVisible?: QueryDocumentSnapshot<DocumentData> | null
    }

    /**
     * Fiddle API and render load status
     */
    loading: boolean;
    ressourcesLoading: boolean,
    fiddlesHistoryLoading: boolean
    iframeLoading: boolean;
}

import { createFeatureSelector, createSelector } from "@ngrx/store";
import { FiddleState } from "./fiddle.state";
import { FiddleApiResponseState } from "./fiddle-api-response.state";

export const selectFiddleState = createFeatureSelector<FiddleState>("fiddleState");

export const selectFiddleApiResponseState = createFeatureSelector<FiddleApiResponseState>("fiddleApiResponseState");

export const selectFiddleData = createSelector(selectFiddleState, state => state.fiddleData);
export const selectRuntimeLayoutData = createSelector(selectFiddleState, state => state.runtimeLayoutData);

export const selectFiddlesHistoryList = createSelector(selectFiddleState, state => state.fiddlesHistoryList.data);
export const selectFiddlesHistoryListPage = createSelector(selectFiddleState, state => state.fiddlesHistoryList.page || 1);
export const selectFiddlesHistoryListTotalPages = createSelector(selectFiddleState, state => state.fiddlesHistoryList.totalPages)


export const selectLoadingStatus = createSelector(selectFiddleState, state => state.loading);
export const selectRessourcesLoadingStatus = createSelector(selectFiddleState, state => state.ressourcesLoading);
export const selectFiddlesHistoryLoadingStatus = createSelector(selectFiddleState, state => state.fiddlesHistoryLoading);
export const selectIframeLoadingStatus = createSelector(selectFiddleState, state => state.iframeLoading)
////

import { inject, Injectable } from "@angular/core";
import { Actions, createEffect, ofType } from "@ngrx/effects";
import { MainService } from "../services/main.service";
import { catchError, EMPTY, exhaustMap, finalize, map, of, switchMap, takeUntil, tap } from "rxjs";
import * as actions from "./fiddle.actions";
import { FiddleNotificationService } from "../services/fiddle-notification-service";
import { Router } from "@angular/router";
import { environment } from "../../environments/environment";

@Injectable()
export class FiddleEffects {
    private actions$ = inject(Actions);
    private mainService = inject(MainService);
    private notifService = inject(FiddleNotificationService)
    private router = inject(Router);
    requestFiddleFromApi$ = createEffect(() => {
        return this.actions$.pipe(
            ofType(actions.requestFiddleFromApiAction),
            exhaustMap((action) => {
                return this.mainService.getFiddle(action.id).pipe(
                    tap(() => {
                        this.mainService.scheduledRunFiddle = true;
                    }),
                    map((res) => {
                        if (res.success) {
                            return actions.updateFiddleDataApiResponseAction(res.result[0]);
                        }
                        else {
                            return actions.requestFiddleApiErrorAction({ message: res.message })
                        }
                    }),

                    catchError((error) => {
                        return of(actions.requestFiddleApiErrorAction({ message: ((error.error?.message as String) || "API Error").toUpperCase() }));
                    })
                )
            })
        )
    });

    closeFiddlesHistoryModal$ = createEffect(()=>{
        return this.actions$.pipe(
            ofType(actions.closeFiddlesHistoryModal),
            exhaustMap((action)=>{
                console.log("closeFiddlesHistoryModal call from effects !");
                return EMPTY
            })
        )
    }, {dispatch: false})

    requestFiddlesHistoryListFromApi$ = createEffect(() => {
        return this.actions$.pipe(
            ofType(actions.requestFiddlesHistoryListFromApiAction),
            exhaustMap((action) => {
                return this.mainService.getFiddlesList().pipe(
                    map((res) => {
                        if (res.message == "ok") {
                            console.log("getFiddlesList map res from effects: ", res);
                            return actions.updateFiddlesHistoryListAction({ data: res.result, page: res.page?.page || undefined, totalPages: res.page?.totalPages || undefined })
                        }
                        else {
                            return actions.requestFiddleApiErrorAction({ message: res.message })
                        }
                    }),
                    catchError((error: { message: string }) => {
                        return of(actions.requestFiddleApiErrorAction({ message: error.message }))
                    }),
                    takeUntil(this.actions$.pipe(ofType(actions.closeFiddlesHistoryModal)))
                )
            })

        )
    })

    updateFiddleDataApiResponse$ = createEffect(() => {
        return this.actions$.pipe(
            ofType(actions.updateFiddleDataApiResponseAction),
            tap((actionProps)=>{
                if (this.mainService.scheduledRunFiddle || this.mainService.redirectAfterSaveMode) {
                    this.mainService.requestRunCode.next(actionProps);
                }
            }),
            switchMap((actionProps) => {
                return of(
                    actions.updateFiddleDataAction(actionProps),
                    actions.updateFiddleLoadingStatusAction({ loading: false }))
            })
        )
    })

    requestSavingFiddle$ = createEffect(() => {
        return this.actions$.pipe(
            ofType(actions.requestSavingFiddle),
            switchMap((actionprops) => {
                return this.mainService.saveFiddle().pipe(
                    tap((res) => {
                        let appName = environment.appName;

                        let hrefValue = window.location.origin;
                        if (hrefValue[hrefValue.length - 1] != '/') {
                            hrefValue = hrefValue + '/';
                        }
                        let text = hrefValue + (appName ? appName + '/' : '') + res.result[0].id;
                        let tempInput = document.createElement("input");
                        tempInput.style.cssText = `
                            position:fixed;
                            left:9999px;
                            top:9999px;
                            opacity:0px;
                            `;

                        tempInput.value = text;

                        document.body.appendChild(tempInput);

                        tempInput.select();
                        document.execCommand("copy")

                        tempInput.remove();
                        //this.mainService.copyTextToClipBoard(text);

                        this.mainService.removeBeforeUnloadListener();
                        this.mainService.resetCodeSinceSave();

                        console.log("gonna navigate now !");
                        this.mainService.redirectAfterSaveMode = true;
                        this.mainService.scheduledRunFiddle = true;

                        if(res.result[0].appMode == "fiddle"){
                            this.router.navigateByUrl('/playground/fiddle/' + res.result[0].id);   
                        }
                        else{
                            this.router.navigateByUrl('/playground/pastebin/' + res.result[0].id);
                        }
                    }),
                    map((res) => {
                        if (res.success) {

                            return actions.updateFiddleDataApiResponseAction(res.result[0])
                        }
                        else {
                            return actions.requestFiddleApiErrorAction({
                                message: res.message
                            })
                        }
                    }),
                    catchError((error: { message: string }) => {
                        return of(actions.requestFiddleApiErrorAction({
                            message: error.message
                        }))
                    })
                )
            })
        )
    })


    fiddleError$ = createEffect(() => {
        return this.actions$.pipe(
            ofType(actions.requestFiddleApiErrorAction),
            switchMap((action) => {
                this.router.navigate(["/"]);
                this.notifService.showError(action.message);
                return EMPTY
            })
        )
    }, { dispatch: false });
}

import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, EventEmitter, Input, Output, ChangeDetectionStrategy, HostListener, ViewChild, ElementRef, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';

@Component({
  standalone: true,
  selector: 'app-modal',
  templateUrl: './modal.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./modal.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.Eager,
  imports: [FormsModule, CommonModule],
})
export class ModalComponent {
  constructor() {}
  private ref = inject((ElementRef))
  @Output() closeModal: EventEmitter<void> = new EventEmitter();
  @Output() validateEvent: EventEmitter<void> = new EventEmitter();

  @Input() hasValidationBtn: boolean = true;

  @Input() title: string = "";

  @Input() description: string = "";

  show() {
    let dialogElement = (this.ref.nativeElement as HTMLElement).querySelector("dialog") as HTMLDialogElement;
    dialogElement.showModal();
  }

  hide() {
    let dialogElement = (this.ref.nativeElement as HTMLElement).querySelector("dialog") as HTMLDialogElement;
    dialogElement.close();
  }
  
  onValidate() {
    this.validateEvent.emit();
  }

  onDialogClose(){
    this.closeModal.emit();
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, HostListener, ViewChild, AfterViewInit, inject, Signal, signal, ChangeDetectionStrategy, model, WritableSignal, computed, DestroyRef } from '@angular/core';
import { MainService } from "../services/main.service";

import { DomSanitizer } from '@angular/platform-browser';

import { filter, Observable, of, Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { takeUntilDestroyed, toSignal } from "@angular/core/rxjs-interop";
import { FiddleNotificationService } from '../services/fiddle-notification-service';
import { languages } from '@codemirror/language-data';
import type { LanguageDescription } from '@codemirror/language';
import { css_beautify, html_beautify, js_beautify } from 'js-beautify';
import { environment } from '../../environments/environment';

@Component({
  standalone: true,
  selector: 'app-main',
  templateUrl: './main.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./main.component.css'],
  imports: [CommonModule, HtmlPartComponent, CssPartComponent, JsPartComponent, IframePartComponent, FormsModule, LoaderComponent, PastebinComponent, ModalComponent, RessourcesComponent, FiddlesHistoryComponent]
})
export class MainComponent implements AfterViewInit {

  onAppModeClick() {
    let newAppmode = (this.fiddleData().appMode == 'pastebin') ? 'fiddle' : 'pastebin';
    this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
      appMode: newAppmode
    }))
    this.router.navigateByUrl("/playground/" + newAppmode)
  }


  /**
   * A boolean to show or hide a transparent <div> on top of the iframe when dragging gutters, to avoid having the mouse/touch events sucked by the iframe
   */
  showIframeOverlayWithSizes: WritableSignal<boolean> = signal(false);


  isHtmlFullScreen: boolean = false;
  isCssFullScreen: boolean = false;
  isJsFullScreen: boolean = false;

  private windowHeight: number = window.innerHeight;
  private windowWidth: number = window.innerWidth;


  private store: Store = inject(Store);

  private mainService = inject(MainService);

  private notifService = inject(FiddleNotificationService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private sanitizer = inject(DomSanitizer);
  private ressourcesService = inject(RessourcesService);

  @ViewChild("mainContainer") mainContainer!: ElementRef

  @ViewChild("codesPartArea") codesPartArea!: ElementRef

  @ViewChild("htmlPart") htmlPart!: HtmlPartComponent;
  @ViewChild("cssPart") cssPart!: CssPartComponent;
  @ViewChild("jsPart") jsPart!: JsPartComponent;
  @ViewChild("pastebinPart") pastebinPart!: PastebinComponent;
  @ViewChild("iframePart") iframePart!: IframePartComponent;

  @ViewChild("modalRessources") modalRessources!: ModalComponent;
  @ViewChild("modalHistory") modalHistory!: ModalComponent;

  @ViewChild("ressources") ressourcesComponent!: RessourcesComponent;
  @ViewChild("loader") loader!: LoaderComponent;

  fiddleTitle: WritableSignal<string> = signal("");

  pasteBinSyntaxLanguageFilter: WritableSignal<string> = signal("");
  pasteBinSyntaxLanguageList: Signal<string[]> = computed(() => {
    let languagesList = languages.map((lang: LanguageDescription) => {
      return lang.name
    });
    languagesList.push("Text");
    languagesList.sort();

    if (this.pasteBinSyntaxLanguageFilter()) {
      return languagesList.filter((lang: string) => {
        return lang.toUpperCase().includes(this.pasteBinSyntaxLanguageFilter().toUpperCase())
      });
    }

    return languagesList
  })

  showPastebinLanguages: WritableSignal<boolean> = signal(false);

  iframeWidth: WritableSignal<number> = model(0);
  iframeHeight: WritableSignal<number> = model(0);
  IsAfterViewInitReached: boolean = false;

  isIframeFullScreen: boolean = false;

  private mouseDownXorY: number = 0;


  @ViewChild("iframeGutter1") iframeGutter1!: ElementRef
  @ViewChild("iframeGutter2") iframeGutter2!: ElementRef

  @ViewChild("htmlCssGutter") htmlCssGutter!: ElementRef

  @ViewChild("emptyArea1") emptyArea1!: ElementRef;
  @ViewChild("emptyArea2") emptyArea2!: ElementRef;

  isFiddleWidthInputDisabled: boolean = false;
  isFiddleHeightInputDisabled: boolean = false;

  private codePartHalfStretchFirstIndex: number | undefined = undefined;

  isConsoleOn: boolean = false;
  @ViewChild("appFiddlesHistory") appFiddlesHistory!: FiddlesHistoryComponent;


  public fiddleData: Signal<FiddleData>;
  public runtimeLayoutData: Signal<RuntimeLayoutData>;
  private persistedFiddleData$: Observable<FiddleData>;

  public isPortfolioMode: WritableSignal<boolean> = signal(false);

  public isLayoutsListVisible: WritableSignal<boolean> = signal(false);
  public isToolsListVisible: WritableSignal<boolean> = signal(false);
  public isIframeOverlayVisible: Signal<boolean> = computed(() => {
    return this.showIframeOverlayWithSizes() || this.isToolsListVisible() || this.isLayoutsListVisible();
  })

  public isApiDataLoading: Signal<boolean> = this.store.selectSignal(selectors.selectLoadingStatus);
  private isIframeLoading: Signal<boolean> = this.store.selectSignal(selectors.selectIframeLoadingStatus);
  public isDataLoading: Signal<boolean> = computed(() => {
    return this.isIframeLoading() || this.isApiDataLoading();
  })

  constructor(private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private ref: ElementRef,
    private destroyRef: DestroyRef) {
    this.pasteBinSyntaxLanguageFilter.set("");
    this.fiddleData = this.store.selectSignal(selectors.selectFiddleData);
    this.runtimeLayoutData = this.store.selectSignal(selectors.selectRuntimeLayoutData)
    this.persistedFiddleData$ = this.store.select(selectors.selectPersistedFiddleData);
  }

  onTitleInput(ev: Event) {
    console.log("onTitleInput ev = ", ev);
  }

  getMaxFiddleHeight() {
    if ([1, 3].includes(this.fiddleData().layout!)) {
      return this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight! - 10
    }
    else {
      return this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight! - 5 - 350
    }
  }

  getMaxFiddleWidth() {
    if ([1, 3].includes(this.fiddleData().layout!)) {
      return this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth! - 5 - 350
    }
    else {
      return this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth! - 10
    }
  }


  setIframeHeightAndWidth() {
    if ([1, 3].includes(this.fiddleData().layout!)) {
      this.iframeHeight.set(this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight! - this.runtimeLayoutData().partsSizesData?.emptyArea_1_Size! * 2 - 10)
      this.iframeWidth.set(this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth! - this.fiddleData().codesPartSize! - 5)
    }
    else {
      this.iframeHeight.set(this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight! - this.fiddleData().codesPartSize! - 5)
      this.iframeWidth.set(this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth! - this.runtimeLayoutData().partsSizesData?.emptyArea_1_Size! * 2 - 10)
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    //console.log("main-component ngOnInit");
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    if ((window as any).PayPal && (window as any).PayPal.Donation) {
      (window as any).PayPal.Donation.Button({
        env: 'production',
        hosted_button_id: 'V8U6U69Y6BLQ6',
        image: {
          src: 'https://pics.paypal.com/00/s/ZGFkMWU1YzMtOGFiOS00OGFhLWFjMjEtMDkzMWU4YWE4M2Vm/file.PNG',
          alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
          title: 'Donate to MyFiddle',
        },
        debug: false
      }).render('#donate-button');
    }
    //
    this.persistedFiddleData$.pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe((res: FiddleData) => {
      if (this.mainService.isFiddleWithId(res)) {
        //console.log("entering if (this.mainService.isFiddleWithId(res))")
        //console.log("main component persistedFiddleData$ res = ", res);
        if (res.appMode == "fiddle") {
          if (res.isMobileMode) {
            this.changeLayout(1);

            //START mobile layout retrieval
            let mobileLayoutArr = res.mobileLayout?.split(':')!;
            let mobileCodePart = mobileLayoutArr[0];
            let mobileResult = mobileLayoutArr[1];

            let showHtmlForMobile: boolean = mobileCodePart === '1';
            let showCssForMobile: boolean = mobileCodePart === '2';
            let showJsForMobile: boolean = mobileCodePart === '3';
            let showResultForMobile: boolean = mobileResult === '1';

            this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
              mobileLayoutData: {
                showHtmlForMobile: showHtmlForMobile,
                showCssForMobile: showCssForMobile,
                showJsForMobile: showJsForMobile,
                showResultForMobile: showResultForMobile
              }
            }));
            //END mobile layout retrieval
          }
          else {
            this.changeLayout(res.layout!, res);
            //console.log("gonna call changeLayout()!")
          }
        }

        this.fiddleTitle.set(res.title!);
      }
    });

    this.IsAfterViewInitReached = true;

    if (this.fiddleData().appMode == "fiddle") {
      let mainContainerEl;
      mainContainerEl = this.mainContainer.nativeElement;

      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        mainContainerWidth: mainContainerEl.offsetWidth,
        mainContainerHeight: mainContainerEl.offsetHeight,
        isMobileMode: this.isMobileMode()
      }));
    }

    /*
    this.activatedRoute.url.subscribe((urlRes)=>{
      console.log("activatedRoute.url = ", urlRes);
    });

    this.activatedRoute.data.subscribe((dataRes)=>{
      console.log("activatedRoute.data = ", dataRes);
    });

    this.activatedRoute.queryParams.subscribe((queryParamsRes)=>{
      console.log("activatedRoute.queryParams = ", queryParamsRes);
    });*/

    this.activatedRoute.paramMap.subscribe((params) => {

      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        appMode: this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data["appMode"]
      }))

      let currentFiddleId = params.get("id");
      console.log("currentFiddleId = ", currentFiddleId);
      

      //data retrieval
      if (currentFiddleId) {
        this.mainService.currentFiddleId.set(currentFiddleId);
        if (this.mainService.redirectAfterSaveMode) {//router redirect requested after recent save ?
          //console.log("//router redirect requested after recent save");
          let type = this.fiddleData().appMode == "fiddle" ? "Fiddle" : "PasteBin";
          this.notifService.showInfo(`${type} saved ! URL copied to clipboard.`);

          this.mainService.redirectAfterSaveMode = false;

        }
        else if (this.mainService.scheduledRunFiddle) {//router redirect to specific fiddle ?
          //console.log("router redirect to specific fiddle !")
          this.store.dispatch(actions.requestFiddleFromApiAction({ id: currentFiddleId }));
          //call runCode after api data retrieval;
        }
        else {//retrieve data from backend ?
          this.mainService.scheduledRunFiddle = true;
          //console.log("//retrieve data from backend");
          this.store.dispatch(actions.requestFiddleFromApiAction({ id: currentFiddleId }));
        }

      }
      else {
        this.mainService.currentRouterArbitraryUrlData.set(this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data["arbitraryUrl"]);
        let currentRouterArbitraryUrlData = this.mainService.currentRouterArbitraryUrlData();
        //console.log("currentRouterArbitraryUrlData = ", currentRouterArbitraryUrlData);

        //arbitrary-html-based fiddle ?
        if (this.mainService.arbitraryHtmlIds.includes(currentRouterArbitraryUrlData)) {
          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleLoadingStatusAction({
            loading: false
          }));

          this.isPortfolioMode.set(currentRouterArbitraryUrlData === "hassane-ghanmi");
          this.mainService.scheduledRunFiddle = true;
          this.mainService.requestRunCode.next(JSON.stringify({ arbitraryHtmlFromUrl: currentRouterArbitraryUrlData }));
        }
        else {
          console.log('new fiddle !')
          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleLoadingStatusAction({
            loading: false
          }));

          //set new fiddle appMode from activedRoute.snapshot.data.appMode
          if (this.fiddleData().appMode == "fiddle") {
            setTimeout(() => {
              this.changeLayout(1);
            }, 1);
          }
        }
      }

      this.mainService.resumeFiddleTheme(this.htmlPart, this.cssPart, this.jsPart, this.pastebinPart);

    });

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      //console.log("vanilla keydown");
      if ((window.navigator.platform.match("Mac") ? event.metaKey : event.ctrlKey) && (event.code == "KeyS")) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
      }
      let evDate = new Date();

      if ((window.navigator.platform.match("Mac") ? event.metaKey : event.ctrlKey) && (event.code == "Enter" || event.code == "NumpadEnter")) {
        //console.log("ctrl + enter pressed !");
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        this.runCode();
      }
      else if ((window.navigator.platform.match("Mac") ? event.metaKey : event.ctrlKey) && (event.code == "KeyS")) {
        event.preventDefault();
        //event.stopPropagation();
        if (this.mainService.codeSavingDate === undefined || evDate.getTime() - this.mainService.codeSavingDate.getTime() >= 1500) {
          this.runCode("save");
          //(document.querySelector(".share-code-btn.btn") as HTMLElement).click();//meh a workaround for calling runCode("save")
          this.mainService.codeSavingDate = evDate;
        }
      }

    });
  }
  isConsoleOnUpdate(newValue: boolean) {
    this.isConsoleOn = newValue;
  }

  /**
   * Checks if the current theme is dark
   * @returns boolean: true if the current theme is dark or false otherwise
   */
  isFiddleThemeDark(): boolean {
    //return this.mainService.isFiddleThemeDark;
    let isThemeDark = (this.runtimeLayoutData().fiddleTheme!.id == "dark-theme") || false;
    return isThemeDark;
  }

  prettifyCode(type: string): void {
    if (type == "html") {
      let htmlCode: string = html_beautify(this.fiddleData().html!,
        {
          indent_size: 2
        }
      );

      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        html: htmlCode
      })
      )
      this.htmlPart.htmlCode.setValue(htmlCode, { emitEvent: false });
    }
    else if (type == "css") {
      let cssCode = css_beautify(this.fiddleData().css!,
        {
          indent_size: 2
        }
      );
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        css: cssCode
      })
      )
      this.cssPart.cssCode.setValue(cssCode, { emitEvent: false });
    }
    else if (type == "js") {
      let jsCode = js_beautify(this.fiddleData().js!,
        {
          indent_size: 2,
          space_in_empty_paren: true
        }
      );
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        js: jsCode
      }));

      this.jsPart.jsCode.setValue(jsCode, { emitEvent: false });
    }
  }

  selectTheme(selectedTheme: FiddleTheme) {
    if (selectedTheme.id != this.runtimeLayoutData().fiddleTheme?.id) {
      this.store.dispatch(actions.selectThemeAction({
        theme: selectedTheme
      }))
      this.mainService.addThemeStylesheet(selectedTheme);
    }
  }

  getIframeOrHeaderStyleObject(param: string) {
    let iframeHeaderStyleObject = {
      'display': param == 'header' ? (this.isIframeFullScreen ? '' : 'none') : '',
      'background-color': this.runtimeLayoutData().fiddleTheme!.data.colors.bgColor,
      'color': this.runtimeLayoutData().fiddleTheme!.data.colors.fgColor,
      'border-bottom': param == 'header' ? '1px solid ' + this.runtimeLayoutData().fiddleTheme!.data.colors.selectionBgColor : '',
      'flex': param == 'iframe' ? ('0 0 ' + this.getIframeAreaSize() + "px") : ''
    }
    return iframeHeaderStyleObject;
  }

  changeLayout(newLayout: number, fiddleDataParam?: FiddleData) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      //console.log("changeLayout newLayout param = ", newLayout);
      //console.log("changeLayout fiddleDataParam param = ", fiddleDataParam);
      //console.log("------------------------");

      let mainContainerEl: HTMLElement = this.mainContainer.nativeElement;

      if (mainContainerEl) {

        //console.log("mainContainerEl = ", mainContainerEl);
        //console.log("mainContainerEl height = ", mainContainerEl.offsetHeight);
        //console.log("mainContainerEl width = ", mainContainerEl.offsetWidth);

        //console.log("changeLayout() call: fiddleData.mainContainerHeight = ", this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight);

        if (fiddleDataParam) {//backend data retrieval
          //console.log("changeLayout() call: : backend data retrieval change layout !");
          this.getAndAdaptSavedCodesPartSizes(fiddleDataParam);
          this.fiddleTitle.set(fiddleDataParam.title!);
        }
        else {//new fiddle
          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
            mainContainerHeight: mainContainerEl.offsetHeight,
            mainContainerWidth: mainContainerEl.offsetWidth,
            mainContainerSize: [1, 3].includes(newLayout) ? mainContainerEl.offsetHeight : mainContainerEl.offsetWidth
          }));

          //console.log("new fiddle change layout !");
          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
            partsSizesData: {
              emptyArea_1_Size: 0,
              emptyArea_2_Size: 0
            }
          }));
          switch (newLayout) {
            case 1:
              //console.log('case 1');
              this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
                htmlPartSize: (mainContainerEl.offsetHeight - 10) / 3,
                cssPartSize: (mainContainerEl.offsetHeight - 10) / 3,
                jsPartSize: (mainContainerEl.offsetHeight - 10) / 3,
                codesPartSize: 350,
                layout: newLayout,
                mainContainerSize: mainContainerEl.offsetHeight
              }))
              //console.log("self.mainContainerHeight = ", self.mainContainerHeight);

              break;
            case 2:
              //console.log('case 2');
              this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
                htmlPartSize: (mainContainerEl.offsetWidth - 10) / 3,
                cssPartSize: (mainContainerEl.offsetWidth - 10) / 3,
                jsPartSize: (mainContainerEl.offsetWidth - 10) / 3,
                codesPartSize: 350,
                layout: newLayout,
                mainContainerSize: mainContainerEl.offsetWidth
              }));
              break;
            case 3:
              //console.log('case 3');
              this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
                htmlPartSize: (mainContainerEl.offsetHeight - 10) / 3,
                cssPartSize: (mainContainerEl.offsetHeight - 10) / 3,
                jsPartSize: (mainContainerEl.offsetHeight - 10) / 3,
                codesPartSize: 350,
                layout: newLayout,
                mainContainerSize: mainContainerEl.offsetHeight
              }));

              break;
            case 4:
              //console.log('case 4');
              this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
                htmlPartSize: (mainContainerEl.offsetWidth - 10) / 3,
                cssPartSize: (mainContainerEl.offsetWidth - 10) / 3,
                jsPartSize: (mainContainerEl.offsetWidth - 10) / 3,
                codesPartSize: 350,
                layout: newLayout,
                mainContainerSize: mainContainerEl.offsetWidth
              }));

              break;
          }

          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
            iframeResizeValue: this.fiddleData().mainContainerSize! - 5 - 5
          }));
        }

        this.setIframeHeightAndWidth(); // hack for change detection

      }
    }, 1)
  }

    this.changeLayout(layout);
  }

  getAndAdaptSavedCodesPartSizes(persistedFiddleDataParam: FiddleData) {
    let savedLayout = persistedFiddleDataParam.layout;

    let savedCssCodesPartSize = persistedFiddleDataParam.cssPartSize!;
    let savedJsCodesPartSize = persistedFiddleDataParam.jsPartSize!;
    let savedHtmlCodesPartSize = persistedFiddleDataParam.htmlPartSize!;

    let savedCodesPartSize = persistedFiddleDataParam.codesPartSize;

    let savedIframeResizeValue = persistedFiddleDataParam.iframeResizeValue;

    let mainContainerEl: HTMLElement = this.mainContainer.nativeElement;


    let newMainContainerWidth = mainContainerEl.offsetWidth;
    let newMainContainerHeight = mainContainerEl.offsetHeight;

    //console.log("newMainContainerHeight: ", newMainContainerHeight);
    //console.log("this.mainContainerHeight: ", this.mainContainerHeight);

    //console.log("newMainContainerWidth: ", newMainContainerWidth);
    //console.log("this.mainContainerWidth: ", this.mainContainerWidth);
    let oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight;
    let oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight2;

    let newMainContainerWidthOrHeight;
    let newMainContainerWidthOrHeight2;

    oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight = persistedFiddleDataParam.mainContainerSize!;

    if (savedLayout == 1 || savedLayout == 3) {
      newMainContainerWidthOrHeight = newMainContainerHeight;
      newMainContainerWidthOrHeight2 = newMainContainerWidth;
      oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight2 = persistedFiddleDataParam.mainContainerWidth!
    }
    else {
      newMainContainerWidthOrHeight = newMainContainerWidth;
      newMainContainerWidthOrHeight2 = newMainContainerHeight;
      oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight2 = persistedFiddleDataParam.mainContainerHeight!
    }

    /*START readapt code parts sizes (inner)*/
    let sizes: Array<any> = [savedHtmlCodesPartSize, savedCssCodesPartSize, savedJsCodesPartSize];
    this.reAdaptCodesPartSizes(sizes, 0, newMainContainerWidthOrHeight, "inner");
    /*END readapt code parts sizes (inner)*/

    let outerSizes = [savedCodesPartSize!];

    /*START readapt code parts sizes (outer)*/
    this.reAdaptCodesPartSizes(outerSizes, oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight2, newMainContainerWidthOrHeight2, "outer");
    /*START readapt code parts sizes (outer)*/

    this.reAdaptIframeResizeValue(oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight, newMainContainerWidthOrHeight, savedIframeResizeValue!);

    this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
      mainContainerHeight: newMainContainerHeight,
      mainContainerWidth: newMainContainerWidth,
      mainContainerSize: newMainContainerWidthOrHeight,
    }));

  }

  getLayoutInfos(name: string): string {
    let arr = ["htmlPart", "cssPart", "jsPart", "codesPart"]
    switch (true) {
      case name == arr[0]:
        return this.fiddleData().htmlPartSize + "px";

      case name == arr[1]:
        return this.fiddleData().cssPartSize + "px";

      case name == arr[2]:
        return this.fiddleData().jsPartSize + "px";

      case name == arr[3]:
        return this.fiddleData().codesPartSize + "px";

      default:
        return "0px";
    }
  }

  changeTheme() {

    if (this.isFiddleThemeDark()) {
      this.htmlPart.codeMirrorEditor.setTheme("light");
      this.cssPart.codeMirrorEditor.setTheme("light");
      this.jsPart.codeMirrorEditor.setTheme("light");
      this.pastebinPart.codeMirrorEditor.setTheme("light");

      this.selectTheme(this.mainService.themesList[0]);
    }
    else {
      this.htmlPart.codeMirrorEditor.setTheme("dark");
      this.cssPart.codeMirrorEditor.setTheme("dark");
      this.jsPart.codeMirrorEditor.setTheme("dark");
      this.pastebinPart.codeMirrorEditor.setTheme("dark");

      this.selectTheme(this.mainService.themesList[1]);
    }

    this.iframePart.changeConsoleTheme();
  }

    switch (mode) {
      case 'html':
        this.isHtmlFullScreen = !this.isHtmlFullScreen;
        break;

      case 'css':
        this.isCssFullScreen = !this.isCssFullScreen;
        break;

      case 'js':
        this.isJsFullScreen = !this.isJsFullScreen;
        break;
    }
  }

  toggleIframeFullscreen() {
    this.isIframeFullScreen = !this.isIframeFullScreen;
  }

  stretchVertically() {
    if (this.fiddleData().layout == 1 || this.fiddleData().layout == 3) {
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
        partsSizesData: {
          emptyArea_1_Size: 0,
          emptyArea_2_Size: 0
        }
      }));
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        iframeResizeValue: this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth! - 10
      }))
    }
    else {
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        codesPartSize: 350,
      }))
    }
    this.setIframeHeightAndWidth();
  }

  stretchHorizontally() {

      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        codesPartSize: 350,
      }));
    }
    else {
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
        partsSizesData: {
          emptyArea_1_Size: 0,
          emptyArea_2_Size: 0
        }
      }));
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        iframeResizeValue: this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth! - 10
      }))
    }
    this.setIframeHeightAndWidth();
  }

  resetCodesPartSize() {
    if (this.IsAfterViewInitReached) {
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
        codesPartStretchData: {
          codePartStretch: {
            state: false,
            index: -1
          },
          previousCodesPartSizes: undefined
        }
      }))

      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        htmlPartSize: (this.fiddleData().mainContainerSize! - 10) / 3,
        cssPartSize: (this.fiddleData().mainContainerSize! - 10) / 3,
        jsPartSize: (this.fiddleData().mainContainerSize! - 10) / 3,
      }));
    }
  }

  halfStretchCodePart(newIndex: number, event: MouseEvent) {
    let currentCodePartTitle: HTMLElement = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest(".code-part-title")!;

    document.querySelectorAll(".code-part-title [class*='half-stretch-btn']").forEach((el) => {
      el.classList.add("clinging");
    });

    if (this.codePartHalfStretchFirstIndex === undefined) {//first marking ? stretch
      //console.log("AAA");
      this.codePartHalfStretchFirstIndex = newIndex;
      currentCodePartTitle.classList.add("half-stretch-mark");
    }
    else if (this.codePartHalfStretchFirstIndex === newIndex) {//first marked codePart is marked again ? remove stretch
      //console.log("BBB");
      this.codePartHalfStretchFirstIndex = undefined;
      currentCodePartTitle.classList.remove("half-stretch-mark");

      document.querySelectorAll(".code-part-title [class*='half-stretch-btn']").forEach((el) => {
        el.classList.remove("clinging");
      });
    }
    else {//second codePart is the one marked? proceed with resizing the first and second marked codesPart
      //console.log("CCC");
      let mainContainerSize = this.fiddleData().mainContainerSize!;
      let minCodesPartSize = 25;

      let arr: any = [minCodesPartSize, minCodesPartSize, minCodesPartSize];
      let gutterSize = 5;

      arr[this.codePartHalfStretchFirstIndex] = mainContainerSize / 2 - gutterSize - minCodesPartSize / 2;
      arr[newIndex] = mainContainerSize / 2 - gutterSize - minCodesPartSize / 2;


      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        htmlPartSize: arr[0],
        cssPartSize: arr[1],
        jsPartSize: arr[2],
      }))

      //console.log("arr = ", arr);

      this.codePartHalfStretchFirstIndex = undefined; //reset codePartHalfStretchFirstIndex

      //reset stretched codepart state as well

      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
        codesPartStretchData: {
          codePartStretch: {
            state: false,
            index: -1
          }
        }
      }))

      let firstMarkedCodePart: HTMLElement = (this.codesPartArea.nativeElement as HTMLElement).querySelector(".half-stretch-mark")!;
      firstMarkedCodePart.classList.remove("half-stretch-mark");
      firstMarkedCodePart.classList.add("marking-half-stretched-code-part");
      currentCodePartTitle.classList.add("marking-half-stretched-code-part");

      setTimeout(() => {
        firstMarkedCodePart.classList.remove("marking-half-stretched-code-part");
        currentCodePartTitle.classList.remove("marking-half-stretched-code-part");
      }, 510);

      document.querySelectorAll(".code-part-title [class*='half-stretch-btn']").forEach((el) => {
        el.classList.remove("clinging");
      });
    }
  }

  stretchCodePart(codePartTypeParam: string, indexParam: number) {
    if (this.IsAfterViewInitReached) {
      let mainContainerEl = this.mainContainer.nativeElement as HTMLElement;
      let mainContainerSize = this.fiddleData().layout == 1 || this.fiddleData().layout == 3 ? mainContainerEl.offsetHeight : mainContainerEl.offsetWidth;
      let sizes: any[] = [];

      let codesPartStretchData = this.runtimeLayoutData().codesPartStretchData!;

      if (codesPartStretchData.codePartStretch?.state && indexParam === codesPartStretchData.codePartStretch.index) {//codepart already stretched ? resume last codepart size
        //console.log("stretch A");

        let previousCodesPartSizes = this.runtimeLayoutData().codesPartStretchData?.previousCodesPartSizes!;
        sizes = [previousCodesPartSizes.htmlSize, previousCodesPartSizes.cssSize, previousCodesPartSizes.jsSize];

        this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
          codesPartStretchData: {
            codePartStretch: {
              state: false,
              index: -1
            }
          }
        }));

        //console.log("sizes before = ", sizes);

        //START readapt each code part size, previously set before stretching, to current/new main container size
        this.reAdaptCodesPartSizes(sizes, 0, mainContainerSize, "inner");
        //END readapt each code part size, previously set before stretching, to current/new main container size

        //console.log("sizes after = ", sizes);

        //And now, update the fiddleData store state object accordingly
        this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
          htmlPartSize: sizes[0],
          cssPartSize: sizes[1],
          jsPartSize: sizes[2],
        }))
      }
      else {//code part not stretched ? stretch it
        //console.log("stretch B");
        this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
          codesPartStretchData: {
            previousCodesPartSizes: {
              layout: this.fiddleData().layout!,
              htmlSize: this.fiddleData().htmlPartSize!,
              cssSize: this.fiddleData().cssPartSize!,
              jsSize: this.fiddleData().jsPartSize!,
              mainContainerSize: mainContainerSize
            },
            codePartStretch: {
              state: true,
              index: indexParam
            }
          }
        }));

        let htmlPartSize = this.fiddleData().htmlPartSize;
        let cssPartSize = this.fiddleData().cssPartSize;
        let jsPartSize = this.fiddleData().jsPartSize;

        let totalSize = this.fiddleData().mainContainerSize!;

        switch (codePartTypeParam) {
          case ("html"):
            htmlPartSize = totalSize - 50;
            cssPartSize = 25;
            jsPartSize = 25;
            break;
          case ("css"):
            htmlPartSize = 25;
            cssPartSize = totalSize - 50;
            jsPartSize = 25;
            break;
          case ("js"):
            htmlPartSize = 25;
            cssPartSize = 25;
            jsPartSize = totalSize - 50;
            break;
        }

        //Update store state's fiddleData object accordingly for code parts sizes
        this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
          htmlPartSize: htmlPartSize,
          cssPartSize: cssPartSize,
          jsPartSize: jsPartSize,
        }))
      }

    }
  }

  @HostListener("window:keydown", ["$event"])
  onWindowKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
    //console.log("onWindowKeydown ", event.code);
  }

  @HostListener("document:mouseup", ["$event"])
  onMouseup(event: MouseEvent | TouchEvent) {
    if (this.fiddleData().appMode == "fiddle") {
      let evTarget: HTMLElement = event.target as HTMLElement;
      let isToolsBtnClicked: boolean = evTarget.matches(".tools-btn") || !!evTarget.closest(".tools-btn");
      let isLayoutsBtnClicked: boolean = evTarget.matches(".layouts-btn") || !!evTarget.closest(".layouts-btn");
      if (!isToolsBtnClicked) {
        this.isToolsListVisible.set(false);
      }
      if (!isLayoutsBtnClicked) {
        this.isLayoutsListVisible.set(false);
      }

      if (this.runtimeLayoutData().guttersData?.isMainContainerGutter_dragging) {
        (this.ref.nativeElement as HTMLElement).classList.remove("no-selection");

        this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
          guttersData: { isMainContainerGutter_dragging: false }
        }));
      }
      else if (this.runtimeLayoutData().guttersData?.isIframeGutter1_dragging) {
        (this.ref.nativeElement as HTMLElement).classList.remove("no-selection");

        this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
          guttersData: { isIframeGutter1_dragging: false }
        }));
      }
      else if (this.runtimeLayoutData().guttersData?.isIframeGutter2_dragging) {
        (this.ref.nativeElement as HTMLElement).classList.remove("no-selection");

        this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
          guttersData: { isIframeGutter2_dragging: false }
        }));
        //console.log("--------------------------");
      }

      else if (this.runtimeLayoutData().guttersData?.isGutter1_dragging) {
        (this.ref.nativeElement as HTMLElement).classList.remove("no-selection");

        this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
          guttersData: { isGutter1_dragging: false }
        }));
        //console.log("--------------------------");
      }
      else if (this.runtimeLayoutData().guttersData?.isGutter2_dragging) {
        (this.ref.nativeElement as HTMLElement).classList.remove("no-selection");

        this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
          guttersData: { isGutter2_dragging: false }
        }));
        //console.log("--------------------------");
      }

      this.isFiddleHeightInputDisabled = false;
      this.isFiddleWidthInputDisabled = false;
      this.showIframeOverlayWithSizes.set(false);
    }
  }

  @HostListener("document:touchend", ["$event"])
  onDocumentTouchend(event: MouseEvent | TouchEvent) {
    this.onMouseup(event);
  }

  @HostListener("document:mousemove", ["$event"])
  onDocumentMousemove(event: MouseEvent) {
    this.onMousemove(event);
  }

  @HostListener("document:touchmove", ["$event"])
  onDocumentTouchmove(event: TouchEvent) {
    this.onMousemove(event);
  }

  @HostListener("window:resize", ["$event"])
  onWindowResize(event?: Event) {
    let mainContainerEl: HTMLElement = this.mainContainer.nativeElement;
    let newWindowWidth = window.innerWidth;
    let newWindowHeight = window.innerHeight;
    //this.iframePart.switchConsoleMobileMode();

    //(new windowHeight or new windowWidth) and mainContainerEl is truthy ?
    if (this.fiddleData().appMode == "fiddle" && mainContainerEl && (newWindowHeight !== this.windowHeight || newWindowWidth !== this.windowWidth)) {
      //console.log("/!\ window resize event: ");

      this.windowWidth = newWindowWidth;
      this.windowHeight = newWindowHeight;

      let newMainContainerWidth = mainContainerEl.offsetWidth;
      let newMainContainerHeight = mainContainerEl.offsetHeight;

      //console.log("newMainContainerHeight: ", newMainContainerHeight);
      //console.log("this.mainContainerHeight: ", this.mainContainerHeight);

      //console.log("newMainContainerWidth: ", newMainContainerWidth);
      //console.log("this.mainContainerWidth: ", this.mainContainerWidth);
      let oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight;
      let oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight2;

      let newMainContainerWidthOrHeight;
      let newMainContainerWidthOrHeight2;

      oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight = this.fiddleData().mainContainerSize!;

      if (this.fiddleData().layout == 1 || this.fiddleData().layout == 3) {
        newMainContainerWidthOrHeight = newMainContainerHeight;
        newMainContainerWidthOrHeight2 = newMainContainerWidth;
        oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight2 = this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth!
      }
      else {
        newMainContainerWidthOrHeight = newMainContainerWidth;
        newMainContainerWidthOrHeight2 = newMainContainerHeight;
        oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight2 = this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight!
      }

      /*START readapt code parts sizes (inner)*/
      let sizes: Array<any> = [this.fiddleData().htmlPartSize, this.fiddleData().cssPartSize, this.fiddleData().jsPartSize];
      this.reAdaptCodesPartSizes(sizes, 0, newMainContainerWidthOrHeight, "inner");
      /*END readapt code parts sizes (inner)*/

      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        mainContainerHeight: newMainContainerHeight,
        mainContainerWidth: newMainContainerWidth,
        mainContainerSize: newMainContainerWidthOrHeight,

        isMobileMode: this.isMobileMode()
      }));

      let outerSizes = [this.fiddleData().codesPartSize!];

      /*START readapt code parts sizes (outer)*/
      this.reAdaptCodesPartSizes(outerSizes, oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight2, newMainContainerWidthOrHeight2, "outer");
      /*START readapt code parts sizes (outer)*/

      this.reAdaptIframeResizeValue(oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight, newMainContainerWidthOrHeight, this.fiddleData().iframeResizeValue!);
    }
  }

  toggleLayoutsList() {
    this.isLayoutsListVisible.set(!this.isLayoutsListVisible())
  }

  toggleToolsList() {
    this.isToolsListVisible.set(!this.isToolsListVisible())
  }

  /**
   * Re-adapts the iframeResizeValue on window resize or after fiddle retrieval by id
   * @param mainContainerWidthOrHeight .main-container-fiddle's width or height depending on the layout
   */
  reAdaptIframeResizeValue(oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight: number, newMainContainerWidthOrHeight: number, savedIframeResizeValue: number) {
    let newEmptyAreaSizeTotal = (newMainContainerWidthOrHeight - savedIframeResizeValue - 10) / 2;

    //console.log('reAdaptIframeResizeValue() call: oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight = ', oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight);
    //console.log('reAdaptIframeResizeValue() call: newMainContainerWidthOrHeight = ', newMainContainerWidthOrHeight);

    if (oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight != newMainContainerWidthOrHeight) { //viewport size is different than when it was saved ?
      newEmptyAreaSizeTotal = (newMainContainerWidthOrHeight - this.fiddleData().iframeResizeValue! - 10) / 2;
      if (newEmptyAreaSizeTotal > (newMainContainerWidthOrHeight - 10) / 2) {
        newEmptyAreaSizeTotal = (newMainContainerWidthOrHeight - 10) / 2;
      }
      else if (newEmptyAreaSizeTotal < 0) {
        newEmptyAreaSizeTotal = 0
      }
    }


    //console.log('reAdaptIframeResizeValue() call: newEmptyAreaSizeTotal = ', newEmptyAreaSizeTotal);
    //console.log('reAdaptIframeResizeValue() call: fiddleData().iframeResizeValue! = ', this.fiddleData().iframeResizeValue!);
    //console.log('reAdaptIframeResizeValue() call: this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight = ', this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight);

    this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
      partsSizesData: {
        emptyArea_1_Size: newEmptyAreaSizeTotal,
        emptyArea_2_Size: newEmptyAreaSizeTotal
      }
    }))

    this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
      iframeResizeValue: this.getIframeAreaSize(),
    }));

    this.setIframeHeightAndWidth();
  }

  /**
   * Corrects the width/height of each code part area after fiddle retrieval in relation to new mainContainer sizes.
   * @param sizes code part sizes OR the codespart container size
   * @param newMainContainerWidthOrHeight offsetWidth or offsetHeight of .main-container-fiddle
   */
  reAdaptCodesPartSizes(sizes: Array<number>, oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight: number, newMainContainerWidthOrHeight: number, type: string) {
    let minLimit;
    if (type == "inner") {//code parts sizes (html, css, javascript)
      let total = sizes[0] + sizes[1] + sizes[2];
      minLimit = 25;

      let coef = (newMainContainerWidthOrHeight - 10) / total;

      sizes[0] = sizes[0] * coef > minLimit ? sizes[0] * coef : minLimit;
      sizes[1] = sizes[1] * coef > minLimit ? sizes[1] * coef : minLimit;
      sizes[2] = sizes[2] * coef > minLimit ? sizes[2] * coef : minLimit;

      //console.log("sizes inner = ", sizes);

      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        htmlPartSize: Math.floor(sizes[0]),
        cssPartSize: Math.floor(sizes[1]),
        jsPartSize: Math.floor(sizes[2])
      }));
    }
    else if (type == "outer") {

      minLimit = 350;
      let currentCodesPartSize = sizes[0];
      let sizeDiff;
      let newCodesPartSize = currentCodesPartSize;
      if (newMainContainerWidthOrHeight - oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight > 0) { //screen got larger ?
        sizeDiff = newMainContainerWidthOrHeight - oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight;
        newCodesPartSize = newCodesPartSize + sizeDiff;
      }
      else { //screen got smaller ?
        sizeDiff = oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight - newMainContainerWidthOrHeight;
        newCodesPartSize = newCodesPartSize - sizeDiff;
      }

      //Start check if sizes are well between the minimin and maximum allowed values which are [minLimmit...(currentMainContainerWidthOrHeight - 5)]
      if (newCodesPartSize >= newMainContainerWidthOrHeight - 5) {
        newCodesPartSize = newMainContainerWidthOrHeight - 5;
      }
      else if (newCodesPartSize <= minLimit) {
        newCodesPartSize = minLimit;
      }
      //END check if sizes are well between the minimin and maximum allowed values which are [minLimmit...(currentMainContainerWidthOrHeight - 5)]
      //
      //console.log("newCodesPartSize outer = ", newCodesPartSize);
      //console.log("currentCodesPartSize outer = ", currentCodesPartSize);
      //console.log("newMainContainerWidthOrHeight outer = ", newMainContainerWidthOrHeight);
      //console.log("oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight outer = ", oldMainContainerWidthOrHeight);
      //console.log("-----------------------");

      //console.log('here !');
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        codesPartSize: newCodesPartSize
      }));

      this.setIframeHeightAndWidth();
    }
  }

  runCode(param?: string) {
    if (param == "save") {//save ?
      if (this.fiddleData().appMode == "pastebin") {
        this.changeLayout(1);//reset layout since it is a pastebin
      }
      this.store.dispatch(actions.requestSavingFiddle());
    }
    else {//run
      this.mainService.requestRunCode.next(undefined);
    }
  }

  isMobileMode() {
    return (window.innerWidth < 768 || window.innerHeight < 581);
  }

  toggleCodePart(codeType: string): void {
    let showHtmlForMobile: boolean = this.runtimeLayoutData().mobileLayoutData?.showHtmlForMobile!;
    let showCssForMobile: boolean = this.runtimeLayoutData().mobileLayoutData?.showCssForMobile!;
    let showJsForMobile: boolean = this.runtimeLayoutData().mobileLayoutData?.showJsForMobile!;
    let showResultForMobile: boolean = this.runtimeLayoutData().mobileLayoutData?.showResultForMobile!;

    switch (codeType) {
      case "html":
        showHtmlForMobile = !showHtmlForMobile;
        showCssForMobile = false;
        showJsForMobile = false;

        if (!showHtmlForMobile) {
          showResultForMobile = true;
        }
        break;

      case "css":
        showCssForMobile = !showCssForMobile;
        showHtmlForMobile = false;
        showJsForMobile = false;
        if (!showCssForMobile) {
          showResultForMobile = true;
        }
        break;

      case "js":
        showJsForMobile = !showJsForMobile;
        showHtmlForMobile = false;
        showCssForMobile = false;
        if (!showJsForMobile) {
          showResultForMobile = true;
        }
        break;

      case "result":
        if (showJsForMobile || showHtmlForMobile || showCssForMobile) {
          showResultForMobile = !showResultForMobile;
        }
        break;

    }

    this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
      mobileLayoutData: {
        showHtmlForMobile: showHtmlForMobile,
        showCssForMobile: showCssForMobile,
        showJsForMobile: showJsForMobile,
        showResultForMobile: showResultForMobile,
      }
    }))

    if (!showResultForMobile) {
      if (document.querySelector("app-iframe-part")?.classList.contains("hide-mobile")) {
        //window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize", {bubbles: true, cancelable:false }));
        //clearInterval(editorLayoutFixInterval);
      }
    }
  }
