  getEmptyAreaSize(areaNum: number) {
    if (areaNum == 1) {
      return this.runtimeLayoutData().partsSizesData?.emptyArea_1_Size + "px";
    }
    else if (areaNum == 2) {
      return this.runtimeLayoutData().partsSizesData?.emptyArea_2_Size + "px"
    }

    return "";
  }

  getIframeAreaSize(): number {
    if (this.IsAfterViewInitReached) {
      let size = 0;
      if (this.fiddleData().layout == 1 || this.fiddleData().layout == 3) {
        size = this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight!;
      }
      else if (this.fiddleData().layout == 2 || this.fiddleData().layout == 4) {
        size = this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth!;
      }
      return size - this.runtimeLayoutData().partsSizesData?.emptyArea_2_Size! * 2 - 10;
    }
    return 0;
  }

  /**
   * 
   * @param event MouseEvent (mousedown) or TouchEvent (touchstart)
   * @param gutterNum gutter mumber: 1 || 2 || 3 || 4 || 5
   */
  onGutterMousedown(event: MouseEvent | TouchEvent, gutterNum: number) {
    //console.log('onGutterMousedown ev = ', event);

    //console.log("mousedown event.type = " + event.type);
    //console.log("gutterNum = " + gutterNum);
    //console.log("--------------------------");
    this.mouseDownXorY = this.getPointerCoordinate(event, gutterNum);

    if (gutterNum == 3) {//Main container gutter ?
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
        guttersData: {
          isMainContainerGutter_dragging: true
        }
      }));

    }
    else if (gutterNum == 4) {//iframe first gutter

      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
        guttersData: {
          isIframeGutter1_dragging: true,
          isIframeGutter2_dragging: false
        }
      }));
    }
    else if (gutterNum == 5) {//iframe second gutter
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
        guttersData: {
          isIframeGutter2_dragging: true,
          isIframeGutter1_dragging: false
        }
      }));
    }
    else if (gutterNum == 1) {//html-css gutter
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
        guttersData: {
          isGutter1_dragging: true,
        }
      }));
    }

    else if (gutterNum == 2) {//css-js gutter
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
        guttersData: {
          isGutter2_dragging: true,
        }
      }));
    }
  }

  /**
     * 
     * @param gutterNumber number of current gutter being dragged
     * @param event MouseEvent or TouchEvent
     * @returns current mousemove/touchmove event's clientX or client Y
     */
  getPointerCoordinate = (event: MouseEvent | TouchEvent, gutterNumber: number) => {
    let clientX = event.type == "touchstart" ? (event as TouchEvent).touches[0].clientX : (event as MouseEvent).clientX;
    let clientY = event.type == "touchstart" ? (event as TouchEvent).touches[0].clientY : (event as MouseEvent).clientY;

    let eventClientXOrY = 0;

    let htmlCssGutter = 1;
    let cssJsGutter = 2;
    let codesPartGutter = 3;//not used but created for clarity
    let iframeGutter1 = 4;
    let iframeGutter2 = 5;

    //console.log("move event.type = ", event.type);

    if (this.fiddleData().layout == 1 || this.fiddleData().layout == 3) {
      eventClientXOrY = [htmlCssGutter, cssJsGutter, iframeGutter1, iframeGutter2].includes(gutterNumber) ? clientY : clientX;
    }
    else if (this.fiddleData().layout == 2 || this.fiddleData().layout == 4) {
      eventClientXOrY = [htmlCssGutter, cssJsGutter, iframeGutter1, iframeGutter2].includes(gutterNumber) ? clientX : clientY;
    }

    return eventClientXOrY;
  }

  onMousemove(event: MouseEvent | TouchEvent) {


    let evTarget = event.target as HTMLElement;

    if (this.IsAfterViewInitReached && this.fiddleData().appMode == "fiddle") {

      let emptyArea1 = this.emptyArea1.nativeElement as HTMLElement;
      let emptyArea2 = this.emptyArea2.nativeElement as HTMLElement;

      let mainContainer = this.mainContainer.nativeElement as HTMLElement;
      let codesPartArea = this.codesPartArea.nativeElement as HTMLElement;

      if (this.runtimeLayoutData().guttersData!.isIframeGutter1_dragging) {
        (this.ref.nativeElement as HTMLElement).classList.add("no-selection");
        let eventClientXOrY = this.getPointerCoordinate(event, 4);

        if (!this.showIframeOverlayWithSizes()) {
          this.showIframeOverlayWithSizes.set(true)
        }

        if (this.fiddleData().layout == 1 || this.fiddleData().layout == 3) {//layout 1 or 3 ?
          let emptyArea1_height = emptyArea1.offsetHeight;
          emptyArea1_height = eventClientXOrY - mainContainer.getBoundingClientRect().top; //calculate new emptyArea1_height value

          //make sure emptyArea1_height is between 0 and mainContainer.offsetHeight / 2 - 5
          if (emptyArea1_height < 0) {
            emptyArea1_height = 0;
          }
          else if (emptyArea1_height > mainContainer.offsetHeight / 2 - 5) {
            emptyArea1_height = mainContainer.offsetHeight / 2 - 5;
          }

          //voilà, now we have both sizes of emptyArea_1 and emptyArea_2
          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
            partsSizesData: {
              emptyArea_1_Size: emptyArea1_height,
              emptyArea_2_Size: emptyArea1_height
            }
          }))
        }
        else if (this.fiddleData().layout == 2 || this.fiddleData().layout == 4) {//layout 2 or 4
          let emptyArea1_width = emptyArea1.offsetWidth;
          emptyArea1_width = eventClientXOrY - mainContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left; //calculate new emptyArea1_width value

          //make sure emptyArea1_width is between 0 and mainContainer.offsetWidth / 2 - 5
          if (emptyArea1_width < 0) {
            emptyArea1_width = 0;
          }
          else if (emptyArea1_width > mainContainer.offsetWidth / 2 - 5) {
            emptyArea1_width = mainContainer.offsetWidth / 2 - 5;
          }

          //console.log("mousemove eventClientXOrY = ", eventClientXOrY);
          //console.log("mousemove emptyArea1_width = ", emptyArea1_width);
          //voilà, now we have both sizes of emptyArea_1 and emptyArea_2
          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
            partsSizesData: {
              emptyArea_1_Size: emptyArea1_width,
              emptyArea_2_Size: emptyArea1_width
            }
          }))
        }
        this.setIframeHeightAndWidth();
      }
      else if (this.runtimeLayoutData().guttersData!.isIframeGutter2_dragging) {
        (this.ref.nativeElement as HTMLElement).classList.add("no-selection");
        let eventClientXOrY = this.getPointerCoordinate(event, 5);

        if (!this.showIframeOverlayWithSizes()) {
          this.showIframeOverlayWithSizes.set(true)
        }

        if (this.fiddleData().layout == 1 || this.fiddleData().layout == 3) {//layout 1 or 3 ?
          let emptyArea2_height = emptyArea2.offsetHeight;
          emptyArea2_height = mainContainer.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - eventClientXOrY; //calculate new emptyArea2_height value

          //make sure emptyArea2_height is between 0 and mainContainer.offsetHeight / 2 - 5
          if (emptyArea2_height < 0) {
            emptyArea2_height = 0;
          }
          else if (emptyArea2_height > mainContainer.offsetHeight / 2 - 5) {
            emptyArea2_height = mainContainer.offsetHeight / 2 - 5;
          }

          //voilà, now we have both sizes of emptyArea_1 and emptyArea_2
          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
            partsSizesData: {
              emptyArea_1_Size: emptyArea2_height,
              emptyArea_2_Size: emptyArea2_height
            }
          }))
        }
        else if (this.fiddleData().layout == 2 || this.fiddleData().layout == 4) {//layout 2 or 4
          let emptyArea2_width = emptyArea2.offsetWidth;
          emptyArea2_width = mainContainer.getBoundingClientRect().right - eventClientXOrY; //calculate new emptyArea1_width value

          //make sure emptyArea1_width is between 0 and mainContainer.offsetWidth / 2 - 5
          if (emptyArea2_width < 0) {
            emptyArea2_width = 0;
          }
          else if (emptyArea2_width > mainContainer.offsetWidth / 2 - 5) {
            emptyArea2_width = mainContainer.offsetWidth / 2 - 5;
          }

          //console.log("mousemove eventClientXOrY = ", eventClientXOrY);
          //console.log("mousemove emptyArea1_width = ", emptyArea2_width);
          //voilà, now we have both sizes of emptyArea_1 and emptyArea_2
          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
            partsSizesData: {
              emptyArea_1_Size: emptyArea2_width,
              emptyArea_2_Size: emptyArea2_width
            }
          }))
        }
        this.setIframeHeightAndWidth();
      }
      else if (this.runtimeLayoutData().guttersData!.isMainContainerGutter_dragging) {
        (this.ref.nativeElement as HTMLElement).classList.add("no-selection");

        let eventClientXOrY = this.getPointerCoordinate(event, 3);
        if (!this.showIframeOverlayWithSizes()) {
          this.showIframeOverlayWithSizes.set(true)
        }
        //console.log("mousemove evTarget = ", evTarget);
        //console.log("eventClientXOrY = ", eventClientXOrY);

        if (this.fiddleData().layout == 1 || this.fiddleData().layout == 3) {
          let codesPartWidth;
          if (this.fiddleData().layout == 1) {
            codesPartWidth = eventClientXOrY - mainContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left
          }
          else {
            codesPartWidth = mainContainer.getBoundingClientRect().right - eventClientXOrY;
          }

          if (codesPartWidth < 350) {
            codesPartWidth = 350;
          }
          else if (codesPartWidth > mainContainer.offsetWidth - 5) {
            codesPartWidth = mainContainer.offsetWidth - 5;
          }

          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
            codesPartSize: codesPartWidth
          }));

          //console.log("codesPartWidth = ", codesPartWidth);
        }
        else if (this.fiddleData().layout == 2 || this.fiddleData().layout == 4) {
          let codesPartHeight;
          if (this.fiddleData().layout == 2) {
            codesPartHeight = eventClientXOrY - mainContainer.getBoundingClientRect().top
          }
          else {
            codesPartHeight = mainContainer.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - eventClientXOrY;
          }

          if (codesPartHeight < 350) {
            codesPartHeight = 350;
          }
          else if (codesPartHeight > mainContainer.getBoundingClientRect().height - 5) {
            codesPartHeight = mainContainer.getBoundingClientRect().height - 5;
          }

          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
            codesPartSize: codesPartHeight
          }));

          //console.log("codesPartHeight = ", codesPartHeight);
        }
        this.setIframeHeightAndWidth();
      }
      else if (this.runtimeLayoutData().guttersData!.isGutter1_dragging) {
        (this.ref.nativeElement as HTMLElement).classList.add("no-selection");

        let eventClientXOrY = this.getPointerCoordinate(event, 1);
        //console.log("eventClientXOrY = ", eventClientXOrY);

        if (this.fiddleData().layout == 1 || this.fiddleData().layout == 3) {

          let newHtmlPartSize;
          let newCssSize;
          let newJsSize;


          if (eventClientXOrY > (codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - 50 - 5)) {
            newHtmlPartSize = codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().height - 50 - 5;
          }
          else if (eventClientXOrY < codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().top + 25) {
            newHtmlPartSize = 25;
          }
          else {
            newHtmlPartSize = eventClientXOrY - codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().top;
          }

          let sizeDiff = newHtmlPartSize - this.fiddleData().htmlPartSize!;

          //let htmlPartSize = this.finalHtmlCodesPartSize + sizeDiff;
          //console.log("newHtmlPartSize = ", newHtmlPartSize);

          if (newHtmlPartSize < 25) {
            newHtmlPartSize = 25;
          }

          newCssSize = this.fiddleData().cssPartSize! - sizeDiff;
          if (newCssSize < 25) {
            newCssSize = 25;

            newJsSize = this.fiddleData().jsPartSize! - sizeDiff;
            if (newJsSize < 25) {
              newJsSize = 25;
            }

            this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
              jsPartSize: newJsSize,
            }))
          }

          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
            cssPartSize: newCssSize,
          }))

          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
            htmlPartSize: newHtmlPartSize,
          }))

        }
        else if (this.fiddleData().layout == 2 || this.fiddleData().layout == 4) {
          let newHtmlPartSize;

          if (eventClientXOrY > (codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().right - 50 - 10)) {
            newHtmlPartSize = codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().width - 50 - 10;
          }
          else if (eventClientXOrY < codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().left + 25) {
            newHtmlPartSize = 25;
          }
          else {
            newHtmlPartSize = eventClientXOrY - codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().left;
          }

          let sizeDiff = newHtmlPartSize - this.fiddleData().htmlPartSize!;

          //console.log("newHtmlPartSize = ", newHtmlPartSize);

          if (newHtmlPartSize < 25) {
            newHtmlPartSize = 25;
          }

          let newCssSize = this.fiddleData().cssPartSize! - sizeDiff;
          if (newCssSize < 25) {
            newCssSize = 25;

            ///
            let newJsSize = this.fiddleData().jsPartSize! - sizeDiff;
            if (newJsSize < 25) {
              newJsSize = 25;
            }

            this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
              jsPartSize: newJsSize
            }));
          }

          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
            htmlPartSize: newHtmlPartSize,
            cssPartSize: newCssSize
          }));
        }


      }
      else if (this.runtimeLayoutData().guttersData!.isGutter2_dragging) {
        (this.ref.nativeElement as HTMLElement).classList.add("no-selection");

        let eventClientXOrY = this.getPointerCoordinate(event, 2);

        //console.log("eventClientXOrY = ", eventClientXOrY);

        if (this.fiddleData().layout == 1 || this.fiddleData().layout == 3) {

          let newJsPartSize;

          if (eventClientXOrY > (codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - 25)) {//drag is below codepPartsArea bottom point ?
            newJsPartSize = 25;
          }
          else if (eventClientXOrY < codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().top + 50 + 5) {//drag is above codesPartArea top point ?
            newJsPartSize = codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().height - 50 - 5;
          }
          else {
            newJsPartSize = codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - eventClientXOrY;
          }

          let sizeDiff = newJsPartSize - this.fiddleData().jsPartSize!;

          if (newJsPartSize < 25) {
            newJsPartSize = 25;
          }

          let newCssSize = codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().height - (this.fiddleData().htmlPartSize! + newJsPartSize);
          if (newCssSize < 25) {
            newCssSize = 25;

            ///
            let newHtmlSize = this.fiddleData().htmlPartSize! - sizeDiff;
            if (newHtmlSize < 25) {
              newHtmlSize = 25;
            }
            this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
              htmlPartSize: newHtmlSize
            }))
          }

          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
            cssPartSize: newCssSize,
            jsPartSize: newJsPartSize,
          }));

        }

        else if (this.fiddleData().layout == 2 || this.fiddleData().layout == 4) {

          let newJsPartSize;
          if (eventClientXOrY > (codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().right - 25)) {
            newJsPartSize = 25;
          }
          else if (eventClientXOrY < codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().left + 50 + 5) {
            newJsPartSize = codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().width - 50 - 5;
          }
          else {
            newJsPartSize = codesPartArea.getBoundingClientRect().right - eventClientXOrY;
          }


          let sizeDiff = newJsPartSize - this.fiddleData().jsPartSize!;

          if (newJsPartSize < 25) {
            newJsPartSize = 25;
          }

          let newCssSize = this.fiddleData().cssPartSize! - sizeDiff;
          if (newCssSize < 25) {
            newCssSize = 25;

            ///
            let newHtmlSize = this.fiddleData().htmlPartSize! - sizeDiff;
            if (newHtmlSize < 25) {
              newHtmlSize = 25;
            }
            this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
              htmlPartSize: newHtmlSize
            }))
          }

          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
            cssPartSize: newCssSize,
            jsPartSize: newJsPartSize,
          }));
        }

      }

      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
        iframeResizeValue: this.getIframeAreaSize()
      }));
    }
  }

  onFiddleWidthChange(newValue: number) {
    let newFiddleWidth = newValue;
    if (newFiddleWidth > this.getMaxFiddleWidth()) {
      this.iframeWidth.set(this.getMaxFiddleWidth());
      return;
    }
    let maxFiddleWidth;

    switch (true) {
      case [1, 3].includes(this.fiddleData().layout!): {
        let minCodesPartSize = 350;
        let codesPartGutterSize = 5;
        maxFiddleWidth = this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth! - minCodesPartSize - codesPartGutterSize;

        if (newFiddleWidth <= maxFiddleWidth) {
          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
            codesPartSize: this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth! - newFiddleWidth - codesPartGutterSize
          }))
        }
      }
        break;

      case [2, 4].includes(this.fiddleData().layout!): {
        let iframeGutter1Size = 5;
        let iframeGutter2Size = 5;
        maxFiddleWidth = this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth! - iframeGutter1Size - iframeGutter2Size;


        if (newFiddleWidth <= maxFiddleWidth && newFiddleWidth > 0) {

          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
            partsSizesData: {
              emptyArea_1_Size: (this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth! - newFiddleWidth) / 2 - iframeGutter1Size,
              emptyArea_2_Size: (this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth! - newFiddleWidth) / 2 - iframeGutter2Size
            }
          }));
        }
      }
        break;
    }


    this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
      iframeResizeValue: this.getIframeAreaSize()
    }))
  }

  onFiddeHeightChange(newValue: number) {
    let newFiddleHeight = newValue;
    if (newFiddleHeight > this.getMaxFiddleHeight()) {
      this.iframeHeight.set(this.getMaxFiddleHeight());
      return;
    }
    let maxFiddleHeight;

    switch (true) {
      case [1, 3].includes(this.fiddleData().layout!): {
        let iframeGutter1Size = 5;
        let iframeGutter2Size = 5;
        maxFiddleHeight = this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight! - iframeGutter1Size - iframeGutter2Size;

        if (newFiddleHeight <= maxFiddleHeight && newFiddleHeight > 0) {

          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateRuntimeLayoutDataAction({
            partsSizesData: {
              emptyArea_1_Size: (this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight! - newFiddleHeight) / 2 - iframeGutter1Size,
              emptyArea_2_Size: (this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight! - newFiddleHeight) / 2 - iframeGutter2Size
            }
          }));
        }
      }
        break;

      case [2, 4].includes(this.fiddleData().layout!): {
        let minCodesPartSize = 350;
        let codesPartGutterSize = 5;
        maxFiddleHeight = this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight! - minCodesPartSize - codesPartGutterSize;

        if (newFiddleHeight <= maxFiddleHeight) {
          this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
            codesPartSize: this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight! - newFiddleHeight - codesPartGutterSize
          }));
        }
      }
        break;
    }

    this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
      iframeResizeValue: this.getIframeAreaSize()
    }))
  }


  hideRessourcesModal() {
    this.modalRessources.hide();
  }

  hideHistoryModal() {
    this.modalHistory.hide();
  }

  ressouresBtnClick() {
    this.modalRessources.show();
  }

  showHistoryModal() {
    this.modalHistory.show();
    this.store.dispatch(actions.requestFiddlesHistoryListFromApiAction());
  }

  getCodePartGutterStyle(type: string) {
    let obj: any = {
      "flex-basis": "5px",
    }

    if (this.fiddleData().layout == 1 || this.fiddleData().layout == 3) {
      if (type == "main-container") {
        obj.cursor = "col-resize";
      }
      else if (type == "html-css" || type == "css-js") {
        obj.cursor = "row-resize";
      }
    }
    else {
      if (type == "main-container") {
        obj.cursor = "row-resize";
      }
      else if (type == "html-css" || type == "css-js") {
        obj.cursor = "col-resize";
      }
    }

    return obj;
  }

  validateFiddleRessources() {
    let selectedRessourceAssets = this.ressourcesComponent.validateRessources();
    let htmlCode = this.fiddleData().html;

    selectedRessourceAssets.forEach((el, index, arr) => {
      htmlCode = arr[arr.length - 1 - index] + htmlCode;
    });

    this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({ html: htmlCode }));
    this.htmlPart.htmlCode.setValue(htmlCode)

    this.ressourcesComponent.resetCurrentRessourceChoice();
    this.ressourcesComponent.emptySelectedRessourceAssets();
    this.notifService.showInfo("Ressources prepended to HTML code.");

    this.hideRessourcesModal();
  }

  getVerticalModeState(codePartType: string) {
    if (this.fiddleData().layout == 2 || this.fiddleData().layout == 4) {
      switch (codePartType) {
        case ("html"):
          if (this.fiddleData().htmlPartSize! < 230) {
            return true
          }
          else {
            return false;
          }

        case ("js"):
          if (this.fiddleData().jsPartSize! < 280) {
            return true
          }
          else {
            return false;
          }

        case ("css"):
          if (this.fiddleData().cssPartSize! < 230) {
            return true
          }
          else {
            return false;
          }
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  onFiddeTitleChange(data: string) {
    this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddleDataAction({
      title: data
    }));
    //console.log("@onFiddeTitleChange this.mainService.fiddleTitle = ", this.mainService.fiddleTitle);
  }

  getHomeUrl() {
    return environment.homeUrl;
  }


  prettifyMobileCode() {
    if (this.runtimeLayoutData().mobileLayoutData?.showHtmlForMobile) {
      this.prettifyCode('html');
    }
    else if (this.runtimeLayoutData().mobileLayoutData?.showCssForMobile) {
      this.prettifyCode('css');
    }
    else if (this.runtimeLayoutData().mobileLayoutData?.showJsForMobile) {
      this.prettifyCode('js');
    }
  }

  printFiddle() {
    this.iframePart.printFiddle();
  }

  downloadFiddle() {
    this.mainService.downloadZip();
  }

  onRessourcesModalClose(){
    
  }

  onHistoryModalClose(){
    this.store.dispatch(actions.closeFiddlesHistoryModal());
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    console.log(("calling ngOnDestroy !"));
  }
}

import { Component, EventEmitter, Output, ViewChild, ChangeDetectionStrategy, inject, DestroyRef, computed, Signal } from '@angular/core';
import { MainService } from '../services/main.service';
import { languages } from '@codemirror/language-data';
import { FormControl, FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { CodeEditor } from '@acrodata/code-editor';
import { Store } from '@ngrx/store';
import { selectPersistedFiddleData } from '../store/fiddle.selectors';
import { updateFiddleDataAction } from '../store/fiddle.actions';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
//import { CodemirrorComponent } from '@ctrl/ngx-codemirror';

@Component({
  standalone: true,
  selector: 'app-pastebin',
  templateUrl: './pastebin.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./pastebin.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.Eager,
  imports: [FormsModule, CodeEditor, ReactiveFormsModule],
})
export class PastebinComponent {
  text: string = '';
  languages = languages;

  @ViewChild('codeMirrorEditor') codeMirrorEditor: CodeEditor = new CodeEditor();

  pastebinText: FormControl = new FormControl('');

  private mainService = inject(MainService);

  private store = inject(Store);

  pastebinSyntax: Signal<string> = computed(() => {
    let pastebintextSyntax = this.mainService.fiddleData().pastebintextSyntax!;

    return pastebintextSyntax == "Text" ? "" : pastebintextSyntax;
  })

  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.store.select(selectPersistedFiddleData).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        console.log("(pastebin) selectPersistedFiddleData new value: ",res)
        if (this.mainService.isFiddleWithId(res)) {//new value from PersistedFiddleData with fiddle id ?
          console.log("(pastebin) isFiddleWithId!");
          this.pastebinText.setValue(res?.pastebintext, { emitEvent: false });
        }
        else{//use the curent fiddleData since no id is present, which means either a new fiddle or an app-mode switching is happening
          this.pastebinText.setValue(this.mainService.fiddleData().pastebintext, { emitEvent: false });
        }
      },
    });

    this.pastebinText.valueChanges.subscribe({
      next: (value) => {
        this.store.dispatch(updateFiddleDataAction({ pastebintext: value }));
        this.mainService.setCheckBeforeUnloadListener();
      },
    });
  }
}

import {
  Component,
  computed,
  OnInit,
  output,
  Output,
  OutputEmitterRef,
  signal,
  Signal,
  ViewChild,
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
} from '@angular/core';
import { MainService } from '../services/main.service';
import { Router, RouterModule } from '@angular/router';
import { LoaderComponent } from '../loader/loader.component';
import { FiddleData } from '../models/fiddle-data';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { CommonModule, DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { map, Observable, Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { Store } from '@ngrx/store';
import * as actions from '../store/fiddle.actions';
import { selectFiddlesHistoryList, selectFiddlesHistoryListPage, selectFiddlesHistoryListTotalPages, selectFiddlesHistoryLoadingStatus } from '../store/fiddle.selectors';
import { GitlabSnippet } from '../models/gitlab-snippet';
import { environment } from '../../environments/environment';

@Component({
  standalone: true,
  selector: 'app-fiddles-history',
  templateUrl: './fiddles-history.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./fiddles-history.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.Eager,
  imports: [LoaderComponent, FormsModule, CommonModule, RouterModule, DatePipe],
})
export class FiddlesHistoryComponent implements OnInit {
  isLoading: Signal<boolean>;
  searchText: Signal<string> = signal("");
  fiddlesListSize: number = 0;

  fiddlesHistoryList: Signal<FiddleData[] | GitlabSnippet[]>;
  filteredFiddlesHistoryList: Signal<FiddleData[] & GitlabSnippet[]>;
  fiddlesHistoryListPage: Signal<number>;
  fiddlesHistoryListTotalPages: Signal<number | undefined>;

  @ViewChild('historyLoader') historyLoader: LoaderComponent = new LoaderComponent();

  hideModal: OutputEmitterRef<undefined> = output();

  constructor(
    private mainService: MainService,
    private router: Router,
    private store: Store,
  ) {
    this.fiddlesHistoryList = this.store.selectSignal(selectFiddlesHistoryList);

    this.filteredFiddlesHistoryList = computed(() => {
      return this.generateFilteredFiddlesList(this.fiddlesHistoryList());
    });

    this.isLoading = this.store.selectSignal(selectFiddlesHistoryLoadingStatus);
    this.fiddlesHistoryListPage = this.store.selectSignal(selectFiddlesHistoryListPage);
    this.fiddlesHistoryListTotalPages = this.store.selectSignal(selectFiddlesHistoryListTotalPages);
  }

  getFiddleDate(fiddle: FiddleData & GitlabSnippet) {
    return environment.apiMode == "gitlab-snippet" ? fiddle.created_at : fiddle.createdAt
  }

  goToFiddle(fiddle: FiddleData & GitlabSnippet) {
    let id = fiddle.id;
    if (id) {
      this.mainService.scheduledRunFiddle = true;
      if (this.getFiddleType(fiddle) == "fiddle") {
        this.router.navigateByUrl('/playground/fiddle/' + id);
      }
      else if (this.getFiddleType(fiddle) == "pastebin") {
        this.router.navigateByUrl('/playground/pastebin/' + id);
      }
      this.hideModal.emit(undefined);
    }
    //console.log('goToFiddle fiddle = ', fiddle);
  }

  ngOnInit() { }

  nextPage() {
    let newPage = this.fiddlesHistoryListPage() + 1;
    this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddlesHistoryListPageAction({
      page: newPage
    }));
    this.generateFiddlesList();

  }

  generateFiddlesList() {
    this.store.dispatch(actions.requestFiddlesHistoryListFromApiAction());
  }

  prevPage() {
    let newPage = this.fiddlesHistoryListPage() - 1;
    if (newPage > 0) {
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddlesHistoryListPageAction({
        page: newPage
      }));
      this.generateFiddlesList();
    }
  }

  generateFilteredFiddlesList(res: FiddleData[] & GitlabSnippet[]): FiddleData[] & GitlabSnippet[] {
    let totalElements = res.filter((el) => {
      let arr = new Date(el.createdAt!).toDateString().split(' ');
      arr.splice(0, 1);
      arr[1] += ',';
      let str = arr.join(' ');

      if (this.searchText) {
        return (
          (el.title as string).toUpperCase().includes(this.searchText().toUpperCase()) ||
          str.toUpperCase().includes(this.searchText().toUpperCase())
        );
      }

      return el;
    });

    this.fiddlesListSize = totalElements.length;

    //console.log("totalElements = ", totalElements)
    return totalElements;
  }

  getFiddleType(fiddle: FiddleData & GitlabSnippet) {
    let str;
    if (environment.apiMode == "gitlab-snippet") {
      str = fiddle.file_name!.indexOf('_') > -1 ? fiddle.file_name!.split('_')[0] : 'fiddle';
    } else {
      str = fiddle.appMode || 'fiddle';
    }
    return str;
  }

  firstPage() {
    this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddlesHistoryListPageAction({
      page: 1
    }));

    this.generateFiddlesList();
  }

  lastPage() {
    this.store.dispatch(actions.updateFiddlesHistoryListPageAction({
      page: this.fiddlesHistoryListTotalPages()!
    }))
  }
}

describe('FiddlesHistoryComponent', () => {
  let component: FiddlesHistoryComponent;

<div class="history-container" [ngClass]="{'loading': isLoading()}">
  <div class="search-table">
    <input type="text" [(ngModel)]="searchText" [placeholder]="'Filter'" class="form-control" />
  </div>
  <div class="table-container">
    <app-loader #historyLoader [width]="'100px'" [height]="'100px'" [isLoaderShow]="isLoading()"></app-loader>
    <div class="table-wrapper">
      <table [ngStyle]="{
        'pointer-events': !isLoading() ? 'all' : 'none',
        opacity: !isLoading() ? 1 : 0.3
      }">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Title</th>
            <th>Date</th>
            <th>Go to fiddle</th>
            <th>Type</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>

        <tbody>
          @for (fiddle of filteredFiddlesHistoryList(); track $index) {
          <tr>
            <td>{{ fiddle.title }}</td>
            <td>{{ getFiddleDate(fiddle) | date }}</td>
            <td>
              <a class="fiddle-link btn" (click)="goToFiddle(fiddle)"
                [ngClass]="{ disabled: isLoading() }"><span>Go</span></a>
            </td>
            <td>{{ getFiddleType(fiddle) }}</td>
          </tr>
          }
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="pagination" [ngStyle]="{
      'pointer-events': !isLoading() ? 'all' : 'none',
      opacity: !isLoading() ? 1 : 0.3
    }">

    <div class="prev-page-container">
      <button class="btn first-page-btn" (click)="firstPage()" [disabled]="fiddlesHistoryListPage() == 1"
        [title]="'Go to first page'">
        <i class="fa fa-chevron-left" aria-hidden="true"></i>
        <i class="fa fa-chevron-left" aria-hidden="true"></i>
      </button>

      <button class="btn" (click)="prevPage()" [disabled]="fiddlesHistoryListPage() == 1"
        [title]="'Go to previous page'">
        <i class="fa fa-chevron-left" aria-hidden="true"></i>
      </button>

    </div>

    <span>Page: {{fiddlesHistoryListPage()}}</span>

    <div class="next-page-container">
      <button
        [disabled]="fiddlesHistoryListTotalPages() && (fiddlesHistoryListTotalPages()! <= fiddlesHistoryListPage())"
        class="btn" (click)="nextPage()" [title]="'Go to next page'">
        <i class="fa fa-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
      </button>

      <button class="btn last-page-btn" (click)="lastPage()"
        [disabled]="fiddlesHistoryListPage() == fiddlesHistoryListTotalPages()" [title]="'Go to last page'">
        <i class="fa fa-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
        <i class="fa fa-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

.loader-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  height: 30px;
  width: 30px;
  /**/
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  background-color: transparent;
}

.loader-wrapper .loader-container {
  position: absolute;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
  height: 30px;
  width: 30px;
}

.loader-wrapper.global,
.loader-wrapper.sub-global {
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  z-index: 9999;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
}

.loader-wrapper.global {
  position: fixed;
}

.loader-wrapper.sub-global {
  position: absolute;
}

.loader-wrapper.global .loader-container {
  position: fixed;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 100px;
  height: 100px;
}

.loader-container > div:nth-child(1) {
  border-top: 3px solid #62ad4a;
  border-left: 3px solid #62ad4a;
  border-top-left-radius: 100%;
}

.loader-container > div:nth-child(3) {
  border-bottom: 3px solid #62ad4a;
  border-left: 3px solid #62ad4a;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 100%;
}

.loader-container > div:nth-child(4) {
  border-bottom: 3px solid #62ad4a;
  border-right: 3px solid #62ad4a;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 100%;
}

.loader-wrapper .loader-container {
  animation-name: rotate-loader;
  animation-timing-function: linear;
  animation-iteration-count: infinite;
  animation-duration: 0.5s;
}

.loader-wrapper.loader-wrapper.global .loader-container {
  animation-name: rotate-loader-global;
  animation-timing-function: linear;
  animation-iteration-count: infinite;
  animation-duration: 1.2s;
}

@keyframes rotate-loader {
  0% {
    transform: rotate(0deg);
  }
  50% {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
  }

  100% {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

@keyframes rotate-loader-global {
  0% {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg);
  }
  50% {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(180deg);
  }

  100% {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(360deg);
  }
}

import {
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  Output,
  EventEmitter,
  inject,
  Signal,
  signal,
  computed,
  effect,
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  AfterViewInit,
  DestroyRef,
} from '@angular/core';
import { MainService } from '../services/main.service';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FiddleData } from '../models/fiddle-data';
import { SafePipe } from '../safe.pipe';
import { select, Store } from '@ngrx/store';
import * as selectors from '../store/fiddle.selectors';
import * as actions from '../store/fiddle.actions';
import { DomSanitizer, SafeResourceUrl } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { FiddleNotificationService } from '../services/fiddle-notification-service';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { environment } from '../../environments/environment';

@Component({
  standalone: true,
  selector: 'app-iframe-part',
  templateUrl: './iframe-part.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./iframe-part.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.Eager,
})
export class IframePartComponent implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild('form') form: ElementRef = new ElementRef(undefined);
  @ViewChild('copyInput') copyInput: ElementRef = new ElementRef(undefined);
  @ViewChild('iframe') iframeElement: ElementRef = new ElementRef(undefined);

  @Output() isConsoleOnUpdate: EventEmitter<boolean> = new EventEmitter();

  private mainService = inject(MainService);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);

  private iframeOrigin = environment.fiddleIframeOrigin;

  safeUrl: SafeResourceUrl;

  private store: Store = inject(Store);
  private persistedFiddleData$: Observable<FiddleData>;

  fiddleData = this.store.selectSignal(selectors.selectFiddleData);
  runtimeLayoutData = this.store.selectSignal(selectors.selectRuntimeLayoutData);

  isIframeLoading: Signal<boolean> = this.store.selectSignal(selectors.selectIframeLoadingStatus);
  isIframeReady: Signal<boolean> = computed(() => {
    let bool1 = signal(!!this.iframeElement);
    let bool2 = signal(!!this.iframeElement.nativeElement);
    let bool3 = signal(!!this.iframeElement.nativeElement.contentWindow);

    return bool1() && bool2() && bool3();
  });

  constructor(
    private router: Router,
    private notifService: FiddleNotificationService,
    private sanitizer: DomSanitizer
  ) {

    //console.log("iframe component constructor call !");
    this.persistedFiddleData$ = this.store.select(selectors.selectPersistedFiddleData);

    this.safeUrl = this.sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustResourceUrl(
      environment.iframeUrl,
    );
  }

  private onWindowMessageEventListener = (event: MessageEvent) => {
    if (event.data.type == 'sub-iframe-loaded') {
      //console.log("\n");

      //console.log("START--------sub-iframe-loaded---------------");
      this.store.dispatch(actions.updateIframeLoadingStatusAction({ loading: false }));

      //console.log("sub-iframe-loaded: this.mainService.scheduledRunFiddle = ", this.mainService.scheduledRunFiddle);
      //console.log("sub-iframe-loaded: this.isIframeReady = ", this.isIframeReady());

      if ((this.mainService.scheduledRunFiddle) && this.isIframeReady()) {
        this.mainService.scheduledRunFiddle = false;
        if (this.mainService.arbitraryHtmlIds.includes(this.mainService.currentRouterArbitraryUrlData())) {
          this.runFiddle(JSON.stringify({ arbitraryHtmlFromUrl: this.mainService.currentRouterArbitraryUrlData() }));
        }
        else {
          this.runFiddle();
        }
      }
      else {
        //console.log("Not going to run iframe !");
      }

      //console.log("END--------sub-iframe-loaded---------------");
      //console.log("\n");
    }
    else if (event.data.type == "run-message-received") {
      //console.log("START--------run-message-received---------------");
      this.mainService.scheduledRunFiddle = false;
      //console.log("END--------run-message-received---------------");
    }
    else if (event.data == 'detected-error') {
      //console.log("message event from sub iframe = ", event);
      //this.mainService.isConsoleOn = true;
      //this.isConsoleOnUpdate.emit(true);
    }

  }

  runFiddle(arbitraryFiddleData?: FiddleData | string) {

    //console.log("arbitraryFiddleData = ", arbitraryFiddleData);
    //console.log("typeof arbitraryFiddleData = ", typeof arbitraryFiddleData);
    if (typeof arbitraryFiddleData == "string") {
      let obj: { arbitraryHtmlFromUrl: string } = JSON.parse(arbitraryFiddleData);
      if (this.mainService.arbitraryHtmlIds.includes(obj.arbitraryHtmlFromUrl)) {
        //console.log("calling postMessageToIframe() with run-arbitrary-html")
        this.postMessageToIframe("run-arbitrary-html", obj.arbitraryHtmlFromUrl);
      }
    }
    else {
      let fiddleData = arbitraryFiddleData || this.fiddleData();
      if (fiddleData.appMode == "fiddle") {
        //console.log("inside runFiddle() call!");
        this.store.dispatch(actions.updateIframeLoadingStatusAction({ loading: true }));

        let data = {
          js: fiddleData.js,
          css: fiddleData.css,
          html: fiddleData.html,
          //isConsoleOn: this.mainService.isConsoleOn
        };

        let obj = {
          html: data.html,
          css: data.css,
          js: data.js,
          currentTheme: this.runtimeLayoutData().fiddleTheme?.data,
        };

        this.postMessageToIframe("run", JSON.stringify(obj))
      }
      //console.log("BBB")
    }
  }

  printFiddle() {
    this.postMessageToIframe("print", "")
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    //console.log("(iframe-component) ngOnInit");
    window.addEventListener('message', this.onWindowMessageEventListener);

    this.mainService.requestRunCode.pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        //console.log("requestRunCode runFiddle() res = ", res);
        this.runFiddle(res);
      }
    })
  }

  onIframeLoad(event: Event): void {
    //Probably to be removed soon..
  }

  showConsole() {
    /*let iframeElement = this.iframeElement.nativeElement as HTMLIFrameElement;
    if (iframeElement.contentWindow) {
      let obj = {
        type: 'console-show',
        currentTheme: this.runtimeLayoutData().fiddleTheme?.data,
      };
      iframeElement.contentWindow.postMessage(JSON.stringify(obj), this.iframeOrigin!);
    }*/
  }

  switchConsoleMobileMode() {
    /*let isResponsiveModeOn = window.innerWidth <= 817 || window.innerHeight <= 580;
    let iframeElement = this.iframeElement.nativeElement as HTMLIFrameElement;
    if (iframeElement.contentWindow) {
      let obj = {
        type: 'console-mobile-update',
        isFiddleMobileMode: isResponsiveModeOn,
      };
      iframeElement.contentWindow.postMessage(JSON.stringify(obj), this.iframeOrigin!);
    }*/
  }

  changeConsoleTheme() {
    /*let iframeElement = this.iframeElement.nativeElement as HTMLIFrameElement;
    if (iframeElement.contentWindow) {
      let obj = {
        type: 'change-console-theme',
        currentTheme: this.runtimeLayoutData().fiddleTheme?.data,
      };
      iframeElement.contentWindow.postMessage(JSON.stringify(obj), this.iframeOrigin!);
    }*/
  }

  hideConsole() {
    /*let iframeElement = this.iframeElement.nativeElement as HTMLIFrameElement;
    if (iframeElement.contentWindow) {
      let obj = {
        type: 'console-hide',
      };
      iframeElement.contentWindow.postMessage(JSON.stringify(obj), this.iframeOrigin!);
    }*/
  }

  postMessageToIframe(messageType: string, data: string) {
    if (this.isIframeReady()) {
      let iframeElement = this.iframeElement.nativeElement as HTMLIFrameElement;
      //console.log("Sending run message to confirmed iframe ...");
      //console.log("iframeElement.contentWindow = ", iframeElement.contentWindow);

      iframeElement.contentWindow?.postMessage(
        {
          type: messageType,
          data: data,
        },
        environment.fiddleIframeOrigin!,
      );

    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    //console.log("iframe-part ngOnDestroy");
    window.removeEventListener('message', this.onWindowMessageEventListener);
  }
}

import {
  Component,
  OnInit,
  Input,
  SimpleChanges,
  OnChanges,
  Output,
  EventEmitter,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  effect,
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  DestroyRef,
} from '@angular/core';
import { MainService } from '../services/main.service';
import { CodeEditor } from '@acrodata/code-editor';
import { languages } from '@codemirror/language-data';
import { FormControl, FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Store } from '@ngrx/store';
import { selectPersistedFiddleData } from '../store/fiddle.selectors';
import { updateFiddleDataAction } from '../store/fiddle.actions';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';

@Component({
  standalone: true,
  selector: 'app-css-part',
  templateUrl: './css-part.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./css-part.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.Eager,
  imports: [CodeEditor, FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule],
})
export class CssPartComponent implements OnInit {
  code: string = '';
  languages = languages;
  cssCode: FormControl = new FormControl('');

  private mainService = inject(MainService);

  private store = inject(Store);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);

  isFullScreenMode: boolean = false;
  @Output() toggleFullScreen: EventEmitter<string> = new EventEmitter();

  @ViewChild('codeMirrorEditor') codeMirrorEditor: CodeEditor = new CodeEditor();

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.store.select(selectPersistedFiddleData).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        if (this.mainService.isFiddleWithId(res)) {
          //console.log("(css) selectPersistedFiddleData selector res = ", res);
          this.cssCode.setValue(res?.css, { emitEvent: false });
        }
        else {
          this.cssCode.setValue(this.mainService.fiddleData().css, { emitEvent: false });
        }
      },
    });

    this.cssCode.valueChanges.subscribe({
      next: (value) => {
        //console.log('CSS onCodeChanged CODE', value);
        this.store.dispatch(updateFiddleDataAction({ css: value }));
        this.mainService.setCheckBeforeUnloadListener();
      },
    });
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

const helperToools = {
  notificationWrapperClickHandler: (event: MouseEvent) => {
    let notificationWrapperEl: HTMLElement = event.target as HTMLElement;
    notificationWrapperEl.classList.add("hiding");
    notificationWrapperEl.classList.remove("shown");
  },

  transitionEndEventHandler: (event: TransitionEvent) => {
    //console.log("AA");
    let notificationWrapperEl = event.target as HTMLElement;

    //console.log("TransitionEvent event  = ", event);
    
    if (notificationWrapperEl.classList.contains("hiding") && event.propertyName == "opacity") {
      //console.log("BB");

      helperToools.removeNotificationWrapper(notificationWrapperEl);
    }
  },

  removeNotificationWrapper: (notificationWrapperEl: HTMLElement) => {
    notificationWrapperEl.removeEventListener("transitionend", helperToools.transitionEndEventHandler);
    notificationWrapperEl.removeEventListener("click", helperToools.notificationWrapperClickHandler);
    notificationWrapperEl.remove();
  }
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class FiddleNotificationService {

  notificationContainerEl: HTMLDivElement;

  constructor() {
    this.notificationContainerEl = document.createElement("div");
    this.notificationContainerEl.className = "notification-container";

    let notificationsStyleEl = document.createElement("style");

    notificationsStyleEl.id = "notifications-style";
    notificationsStyleEl.textContent = `
    .notification-container {
      position: fixed;
      right: 5px;
      top: 5px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 25px;
      z-index:10000;
    }

    .notification-wrapper {
      box-shadow: 0px 0px 3px 0px gray;
      border-radius: 5px;
      width: 280px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
      color: white;
      font-weight: 800;
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
      color: white;

      transition: 0.5s opacity;
      transition-timing-function: linear;

      opacity:0;
    }

    .info.notification-wrapper {
      background-color: #51a351e0;
    }

    .notification-wrapper.shown {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .warning.notification-wrapper {
      background-color: #f89406e0;
    }

    .error.notification-wrapper {
      background-color: #bd362fe0;
    }

    .notification-wrapper p {
      padding: 10px 0px 10px 10px;
      margin-top: 5px;
      margin-bottom: 5px;
    }
    `
    document.head.appendChild(notificationsStyleEl);
    document.body.appendChild(this.notificationContainerEl);
  }

  createNotificationWrapperElement(msg: string, className: string): HTMLElement {
    let notificationWrapper = document.createElement("div");
    notificationWrapper.className = `notification-wrapper ${className}`;

    let pEl = document.createElement("p");
    pEl.className = "notification-text";
    pEl.style.pointerEvents = "none";
    pEl.textContent = msg;

    notificationWrapper.appendChild(pEl);

    return notificationWrapper;
  }

  renderNotificationWrapper(newNotificationEl: HTMLElement, duration?: number) {
    this.notificationContainerEl.prepend(newNotificationEl);

    newNotificationEl.addEventListener("click", helperToools.notificationWrapperClickHandler);
    newNotificationEl.addEventListener("transitionend", helperToools.transitionEndEventHandler);

    setTimeout(() => {
      newNotificationEl.classList.add("shown");
    }, 1)
 

    setTimeout(() => {
      if (newNotificationEl) {
        newNotificationEl.classList.add("hiding");
        newNotificationEl.classList.remove("shown");
      }
    }, duration || 3000);
  }

  showError(msg: string, duration?: number) {
    let newNotificationEl = this.createNotificationWrapperElement(msg, "error");
    this.renderNotificationWrapper(newNotificationEl, duration);
  }

  showWarning(msg: string, duration?: number) {
    let newNotificationEl = this.createNotificationWrapperElement(msg, "warning");
    this.renderNotificationWrapper(newNotificationEl, duration);
  }

  showInfo(msg: string, duration?: number) {
    let newNotificationEl = this.createNotificationWrapperElement(msg, "info");
    this.renderNotificationWrapper(newNotificationEl, duration);
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable, of } from 'rxjs';
import { CachedCdnjsMetaData } from '../models/cached-cdnjs-meta-data';
import { filter, map, take, tap } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { CdnjsLibraryMetaData } from '../models/cdnjs-meta-data';
import { CdnjsLibrariesSearchResult } from '../models/cdnjs-libraries-search-result';
import { CdnjsLibraryAssets } from '../models/cdnjs-library-assets';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class RessourcesService {

  isDataCached: boolean = false;
  cachedRessourcesData: CdnjsLibrariesSearchResult = { results: [] };
  cacheTimedOut: boolean = false;
  cachedCdnjsMetaData: Array<CachedCdnjsMetaData> = [];

  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {

    setInterval(() => {//refresh cdn results every 6 hours within application usage duration without page reload

      this.cacheTimedOut = true;
      this.cachedRessourcesData = { results: [] };
      this.cachedCdnjsMetaData = [];

    }, 3600000 * 6);
  }

  searchForString(srcStr: string, searchStr: string) {
    if (srcStr.toUpperCase() == searchStr.toUpperCase()) {
      return true;
    }
    else if (srcStr.toUpperCase().includes(searchStr.toUpperCase())) {
      return true;
    }
    else {
      let strsArr = searchStr.split(" ").filter(str => !!str.length);
      let counter = 0;
      for (var ind = 0; ind < strsArr.length; ind++) {
        let str = strsArr[ind];
        if (srcStr.toUpperCase().includes(str.toUpperCase())) {
          counter++;
        }
      }
      if (counter == strsArr.length) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  getRessourcesBySearch(searchString: string): Observable<CdnjsLibrariesSearchResult> {

    let newRessources = this.http.get<CdnjsLibrariesSearchResult>("https://api.cdnjs.com/libraries?search=" + searchString + "&fields=name,description,version&limit=20").
      pipe(
        map((res) => {
          let res2 = res;

          res2.results = res2.results.filter((libraryData) => {
            return this.searchForString(libraryData.name!, searchString);
          });

          res2.results.sort((a, b) => {
            if (a.name!.length > b.name!.length) {
              return 1;
            }
            else if (a.name!.length < b.name!.length) {
              return -1;
            }
            else {
              if (a.name!.toUpperCase() > b.name!.toUpperCase()) {
                return 1;
              }
              else {
                return -1;
              }
            }
          });

          //console.log("network res2.results = ", res2.results);
          //console.log("------------------------");

          res2.results.forEach((libraryData) => {
            let ind = this.cachedRessourcesData.results.findIndex((cachedLibraryData) => {
              return cachedLibraryData.name?.toUpperCase() == libraryData.name?.toUpperCase();
            });

            if (ind === -1) {//retrieved library/ressource is NOT present in the cached search result ? cache it
              this.cachedRessourcesData.results.push(libraryData);
            }
          });

          return res2;
        })
      );

    return newRessources;

  }

  getRessources(): Observable<CdnjsLibrariesSearchResult> {
    let newRessources: Observable<CdnjsLibrariesSearchResult> = this.http.get<CdnjsLibrariesSearchResult>("https://api.cdnjs.com/libraries?fields=name,description,version").pipe(tap((res) => {
      if (!this.isDataCached) {
        this.isDataCached = true;
        this.cacheTimedOut = false;
        this.cachedRessourcesData = res;
      }
      return res;
    }));

    if (this.cacheTimedOut) {
      return newRessources;
    }
    else {
      if (this.isDataCached) {
        return of(this.cachedRessourcesData).pipe(tap((res) => {
          this.cacheTimedOut = false;
          return res;
        }));
      }
      else {
        return newRessources;
      }
    }
  }

  getRessourceMetaData(ressourceName: string): Observable<CdnjsLibraryMetaData> {
    let newRessourceMetaData: Observable<CdnjsLibraryMetaData> = this.http.get<CdnjsLibraryMetaData>("https://api.cdnjs.com/libraries/" + ressourceName + "?fields=assets,description,latest,name,versions").pipe(tap((res) => {

      let ind = this.cachedCdnjsMetaData.findIndex((cachedLibraryMetaData) => {
        return cachedLibraryMetaData.name?.toUpperCase() == res.name?.toUpperCase();
      });

      if (ind === -1) {//retrieved library/ressource metaData is NOT present in the cached libraries metaDatas ?
        this.cachedCdnjsMetaData.push({
          name: ressourceName,
          cachedMetaData: res
        });
      }

    }));

    return newRessourceMetaData;
  }

  getRessourceAssets(ressourceName: string, ressourceVersion: string) {
    let libraryAssets = this.http.get<CdnjsLibraryAssets>("https://api.cdnjs.com/libraries/" + ressourceName + "/" + ressourceVersion);

    return libraryAssets;
  }

}

  addThemeStylesheet(theme: FiddleTheme) {
    let themeStylesheet = document.querySelector(
      'style#theme-stylesheet'
    ) as HTMLStyleElement;
    if (themeStylesheet) {
      themeStylesheet.remove();
    }

    themeStylesheet = document.createElement('style');
    themeStylesheet.id = 'theme-stylesheet';
    document.head.appendChild(themeStylesheet);
    themeStylesheet.textContent = this.prepareThemeStyleSheet(theme);
  }

  getFiddlesList(page?: number): Observable<ApiResponseDto> {
    //console.log("getFiddle fiddleId = ",fiddleId);
    let getAllFromFirebase = async (): Promise<FiddleData[] | undefined> => {
      try {
        let baseQuery = query(
          collection(this.fireStore, "fiddles"),
          //where("isPublic", "==", true), //todo make private and public fiddles
          orderBy("createdAt", "desc")
        );
        let countSnapshot = await getCountFromServer(baseQuery);
        let totalCount = countSnapshot.data().count;
        let lastVisible = this.fiddlesHistoryFireBaseLastVisible();
        let paginatedQuery = query(baseQuery, limit(10))

        if (lastVisible) {
          paginatedQuery = query(paginatedQuery, startAfter(lastVisible));
        }

        let snapshot = await getDocs(paginatedQuery);
        const items: FiddleData[] = snapshot.docs.map((doc) => {
          return {
            ...doc.data(),
            id: doc.id
          }
        })

        let newLastVisible = snapshot.docs.length > 0 ? snapshot.docs[snapshot.docs.length - 1] : null;

        this.store.dispatch(updateFiddlesHistoryLastVisibleAction({ element: newLastVisible }))

        return items;
      } catch (error) {
        return undefined;
      }

    }

    let str = '';
    if (environment.apiMode == "gitlab-snippet") {
      str = '&page=' + this.fiddlesHistoryListPage();
      let gitlabRawSnippetUrl = `https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/${gitlabProjectId}/snippets?per_page=10` + str;
      let obs = this.http.get<GitlabSnippet[]>(gitlabRawSnippetUrl, { headers: headers }).pipe(
        map((res: any) => {
          return {
            message: "ok",
            result: res,
            success: true
          };
        }),
        catchError((error) => {
          return of({
            message: 'Error getting fiddles list',
            result: [],
            success: false
          })
        }),
      );
      return obs;
    } else {
      if (environment.apiMode == "firebase") {
        let res = from(getAllFromFirebase());
        return res.pipe(map((items) => {
          console.log("getFiddlesList items = ", items);
          if (items) {
            return {
              message: "ok",
              result: items,
              success: true
            };
          }
          else {
            return {
              result: [],
              message: "Error getting fiddles list",
              success: false
            }
          }
        }));
      } else if (environment.apiMode == "json-server") {
        str = "&_sort=-createdAt"
        str += '&_page=' + this.fiddlesHistoryListPage();
        return this.http.get<JsonServerApiResponse>('http://localhost:3000/gists?_per_page=10' + str).pipe(
          map((res) => {
            //console.log("json res = ", res);
            return {
              result: res.data,
              message: "ok",
              success: true
            }
          }),
          catchError(() => {
            return of({
              result: [],
              message: "Error getting fiddles list",
              success: false
            })
          })
        );
      }
      else {
        str = '?page=' + (this.fiddlesHistoryListPage());
        return this.http.get<ApiResponseDto>('http://localhost:4200/api/fiddle' + str);
      }
    }
  }

  getFiddle(fiddleId: string): Observable<ApiResponseDto> {
    console.log("getFiddle fiddleId = ", fiddleId);

    let getByIdFromFirebase = async (id: string): Promise<FiddleData | undefined> => {
      try {
        const docRef = doc(this.fireStore, "fiddles", id);
        const snapshot = await getDoc(docRef);
        console.log("getFiddle snapshot = ", snapshot);
        if (!snapshot.exists()) return undefined;

        return { id: snapshot.id, ...snapshot.data() } as FiddleData
      } catch (error) {
        console.log("getByIdFromFirebase error = ", error);
        return undefined;
      }
    }

    if (environment.apiMode == "gitlab-snippet") {
      let gitlabRawSnippetUrl = `https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/${gitlabProjectId}/snippets/${fiddleId}/raw`;
      return this.http
        .get<FiddleData>(gitlabRawSnippetUrl, { headers: headers })
        .pipe(
          map((res2: FiddleData) => {
            let result;
            if (res2.hasOwnProperty('css') && res2.hasOwnProperty('js') && res2.hasOwnProperty('html')) {
              result = {
                message: 'ok',
                result: [res2],
                success: true
              }
            } else {
              result = {
                message: 'Fiddle not found',
                result: [],
                success: false
              }
            }
            return result;
          })
        )
    } else {
      if (environment.apiMode == "firebase") {
        let res = from(getByIdFromFirebase(fiddleId));
        return res.pipe(map((value: FiddleData | undefined) => {
          console.log('getByIdFromFirebase value = ', value);
          if (value) {
            return {
              message: 'ok',
              result: [value],
              success: true
            };
          } else {
            return {
              message: 'Fiddle not found',
              result: [],
              success: false
            };
          }
        }),)
      }
      else if (environment.apiMode == "json-server") {
        return this.http
          .get<FiddleData>('http://localhost:3000/gists/' + fiddleId)
          .pipe(
            map((value: FiddleData) => {
              if (value) {
                return {
                  message: 'ok',
                  result: [value],
                  success: true
                };
              } else {
                return {
                  message: 'Fiddle not found',
                  result: [],
                  success: false
                };
              }
            }),
            catchError((error) => {
              //console.log("error = ", error)
              if (error.statusText == "Not Found") {
                return of({
                  message: 'Fiddle Not Found !',
                  result: [],
                  success: false
                })
              }
              return of({
                message: 'JSON-Server API error',
                result: [],
                success: false
              })
            })
          );
      }
      else {
        return this.http.get<ApiResponseDto>('http://localhost:4200/api/fiddle/' + fiddleId);
      }
    }
  }

  saveFiddle(): Observable<ApiResponseDto> {
    //console.log("saving Code");
    let mobileCodePart = '0';
    let mobileResult = '1';

    if (!this.runtimeLayoutData().mobileLayoutData?.showResultForMobile) {
      mobileResult = '0';
    }

    if (this.runtimeLayoutData().mobileLayoutData?.showHtmlForMobile) {
      mobileCodePart = '1';
    } else if (this.runtimeLayoutData().mobileLayoutData?.showCssForMobile) {
      mobileCodePart = '2';
    } else if (this.runtimeLayoutData().mobileLayoutData?.showJsForMobile) {
      mobileCodePart = '3';
    }

    let fiddleData: FiddleData = {
      js: this.fiddleData().js,
      html: this.fiddleData().html,
      css: this.fiddleData().css,
      pastebintext: this.fiddleData().pastebintext,

      jsPartSize: this.fiddleData().jsPartSize,
      cssPartSize: this.fiddleData().cssPartSize,
      htmlPartSize: this.fiddleData().htmlPartSize,

      codesPartSize: this.fiddleData().codesPartSize,

      mainContainerWidth: this.fiddleData().mainContainerWidth,
      mainContainerHeight: this.fiddleData().mainContainerHeight,
      mainContainerSize: this.fiddleData().mainContainerSize,

      title: this.fiddleData().title,
      layout: this.fiddleData().layout,
      mobileLayout: mobileCodePart + ':' + mobileResult,
      iframeResizeValue: this.fiddleData().iframeResizeValue,
      isMobileMode: this.fiddleData().isMobileMode,
      createdAt: new Date().getTime(),
      appMode: this.fiddleData().appMode,
    };

    this.store.dispatch(updateFiddleLoadingStatusAction({ loading: true })); // todo: change loading status within action calls

    if (environment.apiMode == "gitlab-snippet") {
      let timeStamp = new Date().getTime();
      let body = {
        file_name: fiddleData.appMode + '_' + timeStamp,
        title: fiddleData.title ? fiddleData.title : 'Noname',
        visibility: 'public',
        content: JSON.stringify(fiddleData),
        file_path: timeStamp,
      };

      return this.http
        .post<any>(`https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/${gitlabProjectId}/snippets`, body, { headers: headers }).pipe(
          map((res1) => {
            //console.log("res1 = ", res1);
            return {
              result: [{ ...this.fiddleData(), id: res1.id }],
              success: true,
              message: ""
            };
          }),
          catchError((err1: string) => {
            return of({
              result: [],
              success: false,
              message: err1
            });
          })
        )
    }
    else {
      if (environment.apiMode == "firebase") {
        return from(addDoc(this.fiddlesCollection, fiddleData)).pipe(
          map((documentReference: DocumentReference) => {
            console.log("cloud fireStore documentReference = ", documentReference);
            return {
              result: [{ ...fiddleData, id: documentReference.id }],
              message: "",
              success: true
            }
          }),
          catchError((error) => {
            console.error("cloud fireStore addDoc error = ", error);

            return of({
              result: [],
              message: error,
              success: false
            })
          })
        )
      }
      else if (environment.apiMode == "json-server") {
        return this.http.post<FiddleData>('http://localhost:3000/gists', fiddleData).pipe(
          map((res: FiddleData) => {
            return (
              {
                result: [res],
                message: "",
                success: true
              }
            )
          }),

          catchError((error: string) => {
            return of(
              {
                result: [],
                message: error,
                success: false
              }
            );
          })
        )
      }
      else {
        return this.http.post<ApiResponseDto>('http://localhost:4200/api/fiddle', fiddleData)
      }
    }
  }
  downloadBlob(fileName: string, blob: Blob) {
    let fileUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    let aEl = document.createElement("a");
    aEl.href = fileUrl;
    aEl.download = fileName;
    aEl.style.cssText = "position:fixed; left:0px; top:0px; width:1px; height:1px; opacity: 0px;";

    document.body.appendChild(aEl);
    aEl.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(fileUrl);
    aEl.remove();
  }

  async downloadZip() {
    const zip = new JSZip();
    let fileName = "Myfiddle-file";

    if (this.fiddleData().appMode == "fiddle") {
      fileName = "Myfiddle-" + (this.fiddleData().title || "fiddle");

      zip.file("file.html", this.fiddleData().html!);
      zip.file("file.css", this.fiddleData().css!);
      zip.file("file.js", this.fiddleData().js!);
    }
    else if (this.fiddleData().appMode == "pastebin") {
      fileName = "Myfiddle-" + (this.fiddleData().title || "pastebin");

      let fileExtension = PastebinExtensions.find((obj) => {
        return obj.progLangName == this.fiddleData().pastebintextSyntax;
      })?.fileExtension || "";

      zip.file("text" + fileExtension, this.fiddleData().pastebintext!);
    }

    const content = await zip.generateAsync({ type: "blob" });
    this.downloadBlob(fileName + ".zip", content);
  }
}
